To characterize this gap, we introduce BedBench, a controlled benchmark of thirteen procedurally generated tasks spanning individual judgments and composite answers. Across twelve open-weight and four frontier models, per-color counting exposes a pronounced weakness: humans achieve 93.3% accuracy, compared with 7.2% for the best model. Targeted fine-tuning raises one model's accuracy from 3.0% to 68.6%, but reveals a further difficulty: its answers about the most common colors remain inconsistent with its own per-color counts. Supplying those counts as text improves its judgments, showing that recovering a property does not mean using it consistently. Reasoning, scaling, and added visual cues each improve individual judgments, but none makes exact answers reliable. To locate the difficulty, we probe Qwen3.5-27B: exact per-color counts remain recoverable at the language model's input, yet the model's answers rarely recover them (65.0% for the probe vs. 3.0% for the model). Image-removal controls further show that some apparent successes require no visual evidence. These findings motivate evaluating 3D reasoning by exact correctness, consistent use, and image dependence, rather than accuracy alone. Code and dataset are publicly available: this https URL

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出受控基准BedBench，系统评测视觉语言模型对3D物体精确属性的恢复与一致使用能力，发现模型虽能在部分单点判断上表现较好，但在逐颜色计数等任务中严重失败，表明“感知到信息”不等于“能稳定使用信息”。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在单项判断上可能得到正确答案，但难以恢复并一致地使用3D对象的确切属性，如颜色数量、组合属性等。仅以总体准确率评估会掩盖其在精确性、内部一致性和真实依赖图像证据方面的缺陷，因此需要更严格的评测框架。
AI.method: 作者构建BedBench，包含13个程序化生成的受控任务，覆盖单项判断和组合答案；在12个开源权重模型和4个前沿模型上测试；并开展目标微调、将颜色计数作为文本输入、推理增强、模型规模扩展和视觉线索补充等实验；进一步通过Qwen3.5-27B的探针实验判断信息是否可在语言模型输入处被恢复，并通过去除图像的控制实验检验模型是否真正依赖视觉证据。
AI.result: 实验显示逐颜色计数暴露明显短板：人类准确率为93.3%，最佳模型仅7.2%。目标微调使某一模型从3.0%提升到68.6%，但其关于最常见颜色的答案仍与其自身逐颜色计数不一致。把计数作为文本提供可改善判断，说明模型并非完全无法获得属性，而是难以一致地利用。推理、扩展规模或增加视觉线索能提升单项判断，但不能保证精确答案可靠。探针实验表明颜色计数信息在模型输入端可被恢复的概率为65.0%，但模型自身答案仅3.0%，揭示出表示存在与输出利用失败之间的鸿沟。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张对3D推理的评估不应只看最终准确率，而应同时考察精确正确性、答案一致性和图像依赖性。BedBench揭示了视觉语言模型在恢复确切3D属性并将其稳定用于回答方面的问题，为诊断和构造更可靠的视觉语言推理系统提供了基准与评测方向。

title: FlexTry-On: A Time-Efficient Framework for Multi-Scenario Virtual Try-on
summary: Virtual try-on has achieved remarkable progress in recent years, yet most existing methods are designed for a specific scenario, such as cloth-to-person or person-to-person try-on, and often require separate conditioning strategies and processing pipelines for different settings. We present FlexTry-On, a unified and time-efficient diffusion-based framework for diverse virtual try-on scenarios, including cloth-to-person, person-to-person, cross-domain, and in-the-wild settings. FlexTry-On adopts a common conditioning formulation, where a text-aware condition extraction strategy converts heterogeneous garment sources into a unified representation, and a dual-conditioning diffusion transformer jointly models garment appearance and person identity. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive performance on both cloth-to-person and person-to-person benchmarks while maintaining fast inference. Moreover, the same framework can be directly applied to unseen cross-domain scenarios without requiring separate architectures or scenario-specific processing pipelines. These results highlight the potential of unified and efficient virtual try-on frameworks as a practical step toward more flexible and widely applicable virtual try-on systems.

AI.tldr: FlexTry-On 提出了一种统一且时间高效的扩散式虚拟试衣框架，通过文本感知的条件提取与双条件扩散 Transformer 联合建模服装外观和人物身份，支持 cloth-to-person、person-to-person、跨域及野外场景等多种虚拟试衣任务。
AI.motivation: 现有虚拟试衣方法大多针对特定场景设计，例如服装到人物或人物到人物试衣，通常需要不同的条件化策略和处理流程，导致方法泛化性不足、部署效率较低。
AI.method: FlexTry-On 采用统一的条件化公式：首先通过文本感知的条件提取策略，将异构的服装来源转换为统一表示；然后使用双条件扩散 Transformer 同时建模服装外观与人物身份，实现跨场景的一致虚拟试衣生成。
AI.result: 实验表明，FlexTry-On 在 cloth-to-person 和 person-to-person 基准上取得了具有竞争力的生成效果，同时保持较快推理速度；该框架无需单独架构或场景专属流程，即可直接应用于未见过的跨域虚拟试衣场景。
AI.conclusion: 该研究验证了统一、高效虚拟试衣框架的可行性，为构建更灵活、更广泛适用的实际虚拟试衣系统提供了方向。

title: Look at Where You Think: Localization-Head Alignment for Fine-Grained Perception in Thinking VLMs
summary: Thinking vision-language models reason for thousands of tokens, yet still miss small details in high-resolution images. Zooming methods pay for extra inference passes, and outcome rewards never tell the model where to look at. In Qwen3.5-4B, we find that the bottleneck is selection, not seeing: a few attention heads, which we call localization heads, pick the evidence out of thousands of visual tokens; ablating four of them costs 13.2 points more than ablating four random heads, and their focus fades as the reasoning grows. We therefore propose Localization-Head Alignment (LHA), which makes attention a training signal: whenever the reasoning states a visual fact, these heads learn to look at the focal region rather than the background, as an auxiliary loss in both SFT and RL training. On benchmarks of V*, HR-Bench 4K and TreeBench, LHA lifts Qwen3.5-4B from 74.1% to 76.6% accuracy, the best single-pass 4B result we evaluate, ahead of multi-pass zooming and released 7B models. Alignment alone adds 1.8 points over otherwise identical training while shortening reasoning by 20%, and the gains carry over to Qwen2.5-VL-3B.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Localization-Head Alignment（LHA），通过将注意力作为可训练信号，使视觉语言模型在推理时更关注图像中的关键局部区域，从而提升高分辨率细粒度视觉问答能力。
AI.motivation: 现有“思考型”视觉语言模型即使进行长链推理，仍容易忽略高分辨率图像中的小细节；已有 zoom-in 方法需要额外推理轮次、成本较高，且仅依赖最终结果奖励，无法告诉模型应该“看哪里”。
AI.method: 作者在 Qwen3.5-4B 中观察到少数“localization heads”负责从大量视觉 token 中挑选证据，其聚焦能力会随推理变长而减弱。据此提出 LHA：当推理文本提到视觉事实时，通过辅助损失促使这些注意力头关注对应目标区域而非背景，并将其同时用于 SFT 和 RL 训练。
AI.result: 在 V*、HR-Bench 4K 和 TreeBench 上，LHA 将 Qwen3.5-4B 的准确率从 74.1% 提升到 76.6%，为作者所评估的最佳单次推理 4B 结果，并超过多轮 zoom-in 方法和已发布 7B 模型。仅加入对齐目标即可相对相同训练流程提升 1.8 分，同时推理长度缩短 20%，并且增益可迁移到 Qwen2.5-VL-3B。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明模型瓶颈更在于“如何选择视觉证据”而非“能否看见”，将注意力定位过程显式纳入训练信号，可同时提升细粒度视觉推理性能与效率。

title: AB-Attention: Accurate Block Attention for Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Video diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos, but the quadratic cost of 3D full attention dominates their inference. Dynamic block-sparse attention reduces this cost by computing exact attention only on key/value blocks selected from current activations. However, its fidelity degrades under aggressive sparsity: blocks are scored from coarse summaries or formed by costly global clustering, pruned blocks vanish from the softmax, and whole tiles are kept or dropped even when only a few of their keys matter. To address these limitations, we propose Accurate Block Attention (AB-Attention), a training-free method that accurately approximates dense attention at high sparsity. Its Intra-Block Clustering Selector (IBCS) estimates block importance faithfully yet cheaply by clustering queries only within each query block, without permuting tokens. Sampling with Inclusion-Probability Weighting (SIP) then samples blocks in proportion to these estimates and reweights them by inverse inclusion probability, so that one pass estimates dense attention rather than truncating it. Finally, its kernel gathers key/value blocks much smaller than a tile into full tensor-core tiles, refining selection at no extra tensor-core cost. On Wan2.1 and HunyuanVideo, AB-Attention skips 89--92\% of attention, whereas the baselines compute 1.8--3.6$\times$ as much, yet it still improves PSNR by up to 4.4~dB over the strongest baseline and achieves up to 2.23$\times$ end-to-end speedup. Our code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 论文提出免训练的 Accurate Block Attention（AB-Attention），通过块内查询聚类选择、包含概率加权采样和细粒度 KV 块收集，在高稀疏度下更准确地近似 3D 密集注意力，显著降低视频扩散 Transformer 的推理开销并提升质量。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散 Transformer 的 3D 全注意力具有二次复杂度，严重制约推理效率。动态块稀疏注意力虽能降低成本，但在高稀疏率下保真度下降：块重要性常由粗粒度摘要或昂贵的全局聚类估计；被剪枝的键值块直接从 softmax 中消失；整块保留或删除无法适应稀疏注意力分布，导致质量损失。
AI.method: AB-Attention 包含三个核心组件：（1）Intra-Block Clustering Selector（IBCS）：仅在每个查询块内部对查询聚类，以低成本但更真实地估计键值块重要性，且不打乱 token；（2）Sampling with Inclusion-Probability Weighting（SIP）：按估计重要性采样键值块，并用逆包含概率重新加权，使单次采样即可近似完整密集注意力，而非直接截断；（3）细粒度 KV 收集核：将远小于 tile 的关键/价值块聚合填充到完整的 tensor-core tile 中，在不增加 tensor-core 计算成本的前提下细化注意力选择。
AI.result: 在 Wan2.1 和 HunyuanVideo 上，AB-Attention 可跳过 89%–92% 的注意力计算，而基线方法需要多计算 1.8–3.6 倍注意力；同时相比最强基线，PSNR 最高提升 4.4 dB，端到端推理加速最高达 2.23 倍。
AI.conclusion: AB-Attention 通过块内重要性估计、概率加权采样和细粒度 KV 收集，有效缓解了动态块稀疏注意力在高稀疏率下的保真度损失，实现免训练、高质量、高效率的视频扩散 Transformer 推理。

title: EditAgent: Rethinking Agentic Image Editing
summary: Agentic image editors decompose complex requests into steps, but when a step fails, they mostly retry with the same narrow set of tools and a judge that scores each output by eye directly. We argue that such agents are bounded by two spaces: the action space of what the agent can do, and the observation space of what its judge can see. On our expert-annotated benchmark, a general-purpose editor yields no usable result in over 40% of the cases, and no judge is reliable across edit types. We present EditAgent, which expands both spaces. It routes each step to general editors and specialized methods, and attaches to each candidate a verification record. With these records, off-the-shelf VLM judges outperform finetuned reward models. Candidates are generated in parallel and judged in one listwise call: experts prefer this to sequential refinement in 78.5% of decided comparisons, at no more than half the judge calls. EditAgent improves two open-weight editors on three benchmarks and serves as a data engine for training stronger editors.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出EditAgent，通过扩展智能图像编辑器的“动作空间”和“观察空间”，让通用编辑器、专业方法并行生成候选结果，并用带验证记录的列表式VLM评判选择高质量编辑，从而提升复杂图像编辑请求的成功率与评测可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有智能图像编辑器在步骤失败时主要依赖狭窄工具集重复尝试，并由视觉模型直接按外观打分，容易受到动作空间不足和观察空间不可靠的限制。论文指出：一个通用编辑器在专家标注基准上超过40%的案例无法产生可用结果，而且没有一种评判器能稳定适用于所有编辑类型。
AI.method: EditAgent为每个编辑步骤路由到通用编辑器和专业编辑方法，并行生成多个候选结果，同时为每个候选附加验证记录。随后利用现成VLM作为评判器，通过一次列表式比较对候选进行排序和选择，而不是逐条调用奖励模型或依赖顺序式逐步修正。验证记录使VLM评判优于微调奖励模型，并行生成加列表式评判提高了效率与决策质量。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，EditAgent改进了两个开源权重图像编辑器。专家比较显示，在形成偏好结论的案例中，78.5%更偏好这种并行候选加列表式评判的机制，而非顺序式精修，同时评判调用不超过其一半。该方法还可作为数据引擎，用于训练更强的图像编辑器。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时扩展智能图像编辑器的可操作工具空间和可观察评判信息，EditAgent能够显著缓解复杂图像编辑中的失败重试和不可靠评判问题，为高质量、可扩展的图像编辑智能体与训练数据生成提供了有效路径。

title: DEQ-Stereo: Deep Euilibrium Video Stereo Matching via Adaptive Convergence
summary: Iterative refinement models have significantly improved stereo matching accuracy, but their rigid, fixed update schedules incur heavy computational costs and a strict trade-off between speed and accuracy. This challenge is magnified in video streams, where traditional online methods resort to reducing feature channels or relying on expensive temporal warping. To address this, we propose \textbf{DEQ-Stereo}, a novel video stereo matching framework based on the Deep Equilibrium (DEQ) paradigm. Instead of unrolling a fixed number of iterations, DEQ-Stereo reformulates the refinement as an implicit fixed-point problem, adaptively terminating once convergence is met. To ensure fast and stable intra-frame convergence, we introduce the \textbf{Convolutional Simplified Gated Unit (ConvSGU)}, which eliminates unnecessary non-linearities by modeling the latent state as a gated, element-wise sum of inputs. Furthermore, to exploit cross-frame temporal coherence, we propose \textbf{Temporal State Transfer (TST)}, a warm-start strategy that propagates the converged hidden state to the next frame without requiring explicit pose or warping priors. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that DEQ-Stereo delivers state-of-the-art performance with a superior accuracy-to-latency trade-off.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DEQ-Stereo，将迭代立体匹配建模为深度均衡（DEQ）固定点问题，实现自适应终止，并通过 ConvSGU 与 Temporal State Transfer 提升单帧收敛效率和视频跨帧一致性，在精度与延迟之间取得更优权衡。
AI.motivation: 传统迭代细化立体匹配模型依赖固定迭代次数，计算成本高且精度与速度之间存在严格折中；在视频流场景中，在线方法还常通过压缩特征通道或依赖昂贵的时序 warp 来维持实时性，难以同时兼顾精度、速度与跨帧一致性。因此，需要一种能够自适应停止迭代并充分利用视频时序相关性的立体匹配框架。
AI.method: DEQ-Stereo 将迭代细化过程转化为隐式固定点求解问题，不再展开固定数量的迭代，而是在满足收敛条件时自适应终止。为促进单帧内快速稳定收敛，提出 Convolutional Simplified Gated Unit（ConvSGU），将隐状态建模为输入的门控逐元素求和，减少不必要的非线性。为利用跨帧时序一致性，提出 Temporal State Transfer（TST），将上一帧收敛后的隐藏状态直接传递到下一帧作为热启动，不依赖显式相机位姿或 warp 先验。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，DEQ-Stereo 在视频立体匹配任务中取得先进性能，同时在精度和延迟之间表现出更优的权衡，说明其能够在不依赖传统昂贵时序对齐机制的情况下提升实时性与匹配质量。
AI.conclusion: 该研究的核心价值在于将深度均衡思想引入迭代立体匹配，使迭代次数由收敛行为决定而非固定设置，并通过轻量状态更新与跨帧状态传递提升视频场景下的效率与一致性，为低延迟高精度视频立体匹配提供了新范式。

title: Confidence Filtering in Video-Based Gait Assessment: Measurement Error versus Selection Shift
summary: Video-based gait assessment often keeps only high-confidence pose observations, which can lower measurement error but change the movement assessed. We compared confidence selection with budget-matched random selection in a Parkinson-related cohort (n = 96) and an NF2-related replication cohort (n = 18). In the Parkinson-related cohort, confidence selection produced a small but consistent shift in the observed movement summary (+0.05 SD, 95% CI 0.03 to 0.07), while held-out Mini-BESTest error stayed flat (-0.04 points, -0.13 to 0.05); a policy preserving motion-group proportions reduced the shift, while NF2 showed no shift and its predictor did not beat a constant baseline. Because this shift mixes measurement error with selection shift, we decompose and simulate both on the cohort's window structure. Filtering lowers local error when error depends on confidence, but biases the endpoint once confidence tracks movement more than error. In the Parkinson-related data, confidence was only weakly tied to movement (rho = 0.14). There, filtering is harmless if well-tracked windows are unbiased. If instead systematic error only redistributes within participants, filtering can add up to 0.58 degrees. Unchanged clinical error from such small-cohort predictors therefore cannot show that quality filtering preserves the assessed movement.
comment: 6 pages + 2-page appendix, 4 figures, 2 supplementary figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Rehabilitation Robotics (ICORR)

AI.tldr: 视频步态分析中基于高置信度姿态点的筛选会引入轻微但一致的“选择偏移”，在帕金森相关队列中改变被评估的运动摘要，却不显著降低临床预测误差，因此不能仅凭临床误差不变就认为该筛选保住了原被评估动作。
AI.motivation: 视频步态评估常仅保留高置信度姿态观测以降低测量误差，但这种筛选并非随机抽样，可能改变样本构成或被评估的运动特征，混淆“误差降低”与“选择导致的目标构念偏移”。
AI.method: 在96例帕金森相关队列与18例NF2相关复制队列中，比较高置信度筛选与预算匹配随机筛选对运动摘要、留一/留出Mini-BESTest预测误差的影响；进一步采用保持动作组比例的筛选策略检验偏移来源，并在队列窗口结构上分解与模拟测量误差和选择偏移，分析置信度与运动相关性（rho=0.14）。
AI.result: 帕金森相关队列中高置信度筛选使运动摘要发生约+0.05 SD的偏移（95% CI 0.03–0.07），但留出Mini-BESTest误差基本不变（-0.04分，95% CI -0.13–0.05）；保持动作组比例可降低偏移；NF2复制队列未见明显偏移，且其预测器未优于常数基线。当误差随置信度变化时筛选可降低局部误差，但若置信度更跟随运动本身而非误差，则会引入端点偏差；模拟显示若系统性误差仅在参与者内部重新分布，筛选可增加至0.58度偏差。
AI.conclusion: 基于置信度的质量筛选可能改变视频步态所评估的运动特征，即使临床预测误差未上升或仅持平，也不能证明该筛选保留了原评估对象；在小样本队列中尤其需要结合选择偏移分解、动作组比例控制或构念效度检验来判断。

title: NIF: Normal-Intersection Fields for Geometrically Consistent Oriented Box Refinement
summary: Accurate oriented detection requires a box to follow object boundaries, yet a standard regression head predicts its center, size, and angle from a pooled region representation. Small errors in these coupled parameters can displace long boundaries even when the object is correctly classified. We propose NIF, a refinement module that replaces an additional box regressor with normal-intersection fields. Given a coarse oriented box, the module observes local features at 20 boundary anchors and predicts signed distances along their outward normals. These observations admit an exact affine representation in five geometric variables. A differentiable, reliability-weighted least-squares fit projects the predicted field onto this representation and analytically recovers a refined rectangle. Tangential pooling preserves the normal position profile, while shared projection limits the added network to 0.132M parameters. On DOTA-v1.0, NIF reaches 78.00%, 79.11%, and 79.02% mAP with Oriented R-CNN, LSKNet-S, and Strip R-CNN, respectively, achieving the highest single-scale SOTA result in Table 1. It reaches 68.19% on DIOR-R, improves matched FAIR1M/DIOR-R baselines by 0.30/0.68%, and raises HRSC mean IoU from 0.867 to 0.888 while reducing field error by 24.5%. Across four different detector frameworks with the detectors frozen, relative AP75 improves by 1.57-4.18% and COCO-style mAP by 0.42-3.74%, without detector retraining. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 论文提出NIF，一种用“法向交点场”替代额外框回归器的定向框精修模块，通过边界锚点上的法向距离预测和可微最小二乘拟合，恢复精确矩形，提升定向目标检测精度。
AI.motivation: 标准回归头从池化特征预测中心、尺寸和角度等耦合参数，微小误差会导致长边界错位；现有精修依赖额外框回归器，需要更稳定、低参数、可即插即用的定向框精修方式。
AI.method: 给定粗定向框，在20个边界锚点观察局部特征，并预测沿外法线方向的带符号距离；利用这些观测构建关于五个几何变量的精确仿射表示；通过可靠性加权的最小二乘拟合将预测场投影到该表示并解析恢复精修矩形；使用切向池化保留法向位置剖面，共享投影控制参数量。
AI.result: 在DOTA-v1.0上，NIF与Oriented R-CNN、LSKNet-S、Strip R-CNN结合分别达到78.00%、79.11%和79.02% mAP，获得表1最高单尺度SOTA；在DIOR-R达68.19%，相对FAIR1M/DIOR-R匹配基线提升0.30%/0.68%；HRSC平均IoU从0.867提升到0.888，场误差降低24.5%；四个检测框架冻结下，AP75相对提升1.57–4.18%，COCO式mAP提升0.42–3.74%。
AI.conclusion: NIF以法向几何建模替代传统框回归，实现轻量、可微、可迁移的定向框精修，在多个数据集和冻结检测器上稳定提升定位精度。

title: WorldProbe: When Video World Models Fall Apart under Long-Horizon Spatial Exploration
summary: Video world models generate future visual observations from camera or action inputs, with the goal of synthesizing persistent 3D worlds that can be explored across time and space. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate short interactions or rely on camera trajectories fixed before generation. The performance of video world models under long-horizon exploration with extensive camera motion remains under-explored. We introduce WorldProbe, a diagnostic benchmark that uses a goal-conditioned multimodal agent to adapt camera actions online during generation. WorldProbe comprises 164 test cases across four probing families. Across 10 state-of-the-art models, we generate more than 1,600 rollouts totaling approximately 800 minutes, with horizons up to 180 seconds. Our evaluation across four dimensions reveals both the degradation of local measures and the emergence of long-range inconsistencies. We find that recent models sustain visual and content quality for longer, while long-range memory and evolution remain weak. These results expose a gap between locally stable generation and persistent world consistency that is largely missed by existing benchmarks. Code and benchmark resources are available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: WorldProbe是一个面向视频世界模型的诊断基准，通过目标条件多模态智能体在线调整相机动作，评估模型在长时程、大范围相机运动下的持久三维世界一致性；实验发现当前模型在局部视觉与内容质量上有所提升，但长程记忆与世界演化仍较弱。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型基准通常只评估短交互，或依赖生成前固定的相机轨迹，难以系统衡量模型在长时程探索和大量相机运动下是否仍能保持连续、一致的可探索三维世界。
AI.method: 作者提出WorldProbe基准，利用目标条件多模态智能体在生成过程中在线规划并调整相机动作。基准包含164个测试案例和四类探测任务；对10个先进视频世界模型生成超过1600次rollout，总时长约800分钟，最大生成时长达180秒，并从四个维度评估生成长视频中的局部质量与全局一致性。
AI.result: 实验揭示了局部指标退化与长程不一致同时出现的现象。近期模型能够在更长时间内维持视觉质量和内容连贯性，但在长程记忆、状态保持和动态演化方面仍然薄弱，暴露出局部稳定生成与持久世界一致性之间的明显差距。
AI.conclusion: 视频世界模型的核心挑战正从短程视觉保真转向长时序世界记忆与一致性维护。WorldProbe通过在线自适应相机探索提供了更严格的诊断工具，指出未来模型需要显式增强长程状态建模、记忆保持与世界演化能力。

title: SCOPE: Semantic COdec Pre-Editing for Object-Preserving Compression
summary: Image compression is increasingly used before machine vision systems, yet standard codecs are mainly optimized for human perception rather than downstream task accuracy. We propose SCOPE (Semantic COdec Pre-Editing), a conditional image pre-editor that modifies images before compression to improve the bitrate and detection accuracy trade-off. The model is conditioned on the codec family and compression severity, allowing a single trained network to adapt to multiple compression settings without retraining or loading codec-specific weights. Instead of uniformly preserving the whole image, the pre-editor learns to protect task-relevant regions while simplifying less important background content to improve compressibility. The resulting rate-accuracy curves show consistent gains across different codec families and detector architectures, together with strong transferability to unseen learned and wavelet-based compression families.

AI.tldr: SCOPE是一种条件化图像预编辑方法，在图像压缩前自适应修改输入图像，以优化码率与检测精度的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有标准图像编码主要面向人眼感知优化，而非机器视觉任务精度，因此压缩会降低下游检测性能。
AI.method: SCOPE通过可学习的预编辑器根据编解码器类型和压缩强度条件化地修改图像，保护任务相关区域、简化不重要背景，以提高可压缩性；无需针对每个编解码器重新训练或加载专用权重。
AI.result: 在多种编解码器家族和检测器架构上，SCOPE一致提升码率-检测精度曲线，并对未见过的学习式和小波式压缩方法表现出强迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 面向机器视觉的压缩前条件化编辑比单纯优化人类感知码流更有效，SCOPE为提升压缩图像下游任务精度提供了灵活且通用的方案。

title: GROME: GROunding Factorized MEmory into Video World Models
summary: Long-horizon consistency is essential for video world models, yet it becomes difficult to maintain once observed content falls outside the context window. Existing memory mechanisms either retrieve history as implicit context, which remains constrained by context capacity and entangles static and dynamic information or consolidate history into explicit global representations, which struggle to model evolving dynamics and accumulate geometric errors. To overcome these limitations, we introduce \textbf{GROME}, a novel factorized memory framework that augments video world models for long-horizon coherence across both static scenes and dynamic entities. GROME operates via three synergistic components: 1)~\emph{Static-Dynamic Factorization} decouples historical evidence into static and dynamic components, preserving static scene geometry and dynamic entity states separately; 2)~\emph{Local Memory Retrieval} selects spatially aligned static history to eliminate geometric drift alongside the latest dynamic entity states to ensure temporal continuity; 3)~\emph{Training-Free Memory Injection} seamlessly grounds the factorized memory into video world models via their native conditioning pathways. Experiments on long-horizon revisit scenarios demonstrate that GROME substantially enhances scene persistence and dynamic entity fidelity over existing methods, all while preserving the visual quality and controllability of the frozen backbone without additional training. Beyond self-rollouts, GROME readily accommodates external observations as plug-and-play memory, unlocking flexible and controllable video continuation and scene exploration.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GROME：一种无需训练的视频世界模型分解式记忆框架，通过静态/动态信息解耦、局部记忆检索和原生条件路径注入，缓解长时序场景中历史内容滑出上下文窗口导致的一致性问题。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型在长时序生成中依赖历史观察，但当内容超出模型上下文窗口后难以保持一致。现有记忆机制要么将历史作为隐式上下文检索，受上下文容量限制并混合静态与动态信息；要么将历史压缩为显式全局表示，难以建模动态演化并累积几何误差。
AI.method: GROME 包含三个协同组件：1）静态-动态分解，将历史证据分离为静态场景几何和动态实体状态；2）局部记忆检索，选择空间对齐的静态历史以消除几何漂移，并检索最新的动态实体状态以保持时间连续性；3）免训练记忆注入，利用视频世界模型原有条件通路将分解记忆接入模型，不改变冻结骨干的生成方式。
AI.result: 在长时序 revisit 场景中，GROME 相比已有方法显著增强静态场景保持能力和动态实体一致性，同时保持冻结基础模型的视觉质量与可控性，且无需额外训练。框架还支持将外部观察作为即插即用记忆输入，用于灵活可控的视频续写和场景探索。
AI.conclusion: 通过分解式记忆设计和免训练注入机制，GROME 有效缓解视频世界模型在长时序生成中的上下文遗忘、几何漂移和动态状态不一致问题，为静态场景持久化和动态实体连续生成提供了一种高效、可插拔的记忆增强方案。

title: LiDAR-SHIELD: A Fully Dockerized Adversarial Robustness Assessment Framework for LiDAR-Based 3D Perception Models
summary: LiDAR-based 3D perception underpins autonomous driving and robotics, yet deploying these models safely requires stress-testing them against adversarial inputs before real-world use. Although state-of-the-art adversarial attacks exist, their implementations are often fragmented across individual repositories, each tied to a specific architecture or task and requiring manual environment reconstruction and model-specific integration code. We present LIDARSHIELD, a unified and fully Dockerized framework that reverses this workflow: rather than installing the target model inside the toolkit, LIDARSHIELD exposes any model through three lightweight HTTP endpoints, namely /info, /forward, and /gradient As a result, connecting a new model or dataset requires only a single loader function or adapter. The framework supports both 3D semantic segmentation and 3D object detection through the same engine-service protocol, integrating a task-aware suite of state-of-the-art attacks, including PGD and Square Attack for segmentation, and point perturbation, point removal, point injection, and LiDAttack for detection. This enables systematic exposure of corner cases and vulnerabilities across heterogeneous LiDAR backbones. The LiDAR-Shield codebase is publicly available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 LIDARSHIELD，一个面向 LiDAR 3D 感知模型的统一、Docker 化对抗攻击评测框架，通过轻量 HTTP 接口将任意目标模型接入通用攻击引擎，支持 3D 语义分割和 3D 目标检测的多样化对抗攻击。
AI.motivation: LiDAR 3D 感知是自动驾驶和机器人系统的重要基础，其安全性需要在真实部署前通过对抗样本进行压力测试。现有 SOTA 对抗攻击方法实现分散，常绑定特定模型、架构或任务，且需要手动重建环境和编写模型专用集成代码，导致复现、扩展和统一评测困难。因此，作者希望构建一个低接入成本、可复用、可部署的统一攻击框架。
AI.method: LIDARSHIELD 反转传统“将目标模型安装进攻击工具箱”的工作流，改为将目标模型以轻量 HTTP 服务端暴露出来，仅需提供三个接口：/info、/forward 和 /gradient。接入新模型或数据集时，只需实现一个 loader 函数或 adapter。框架通过同一引擎—服务协议支持 3D 语义分割和 3D 目标检测，并整合任务感知的多种先进攻击：分割任务包括 PGD 和 Square Attack；检测任务包括 point perturbation、point removal、point injection 和 LiDAttack。整体框架完全 Docker 化，便于环境部署和系统评测。
AI.result: 该框架能够以统一协议连接异构 LiDAR 感知模型，并支持多种针对分割和检测任务的对抗攻击，从而系统性地暴露模型中的 corner cases 和安全漏洞。论文强调其工程可用性：接入新模型只需最小适配代码，攻击评测流程可跨不同骨干网络复用，并且代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: LIDARSHIELD 为 LiDAR 3D 感知模型的安全评测提供了一个统一、可部署、低接入成本的对抗攻击框架，有助于在自动驾驶和机器人实际部署前系统性地检测模型鲁棒性短板，推动对抗攻击评测从分散实现走向标准化和工具化。

title: Open-set multi-view seahorse re-identification from underwater photograph sequences
summary: Automated animal re-identification from photograph sequences can facilitate minimally invasive Capture-Mark-Recapture studies at scale. Yet, photographs taken during an observation session can vary greatly in quality, not always providing the necessary information for accurate re-identification. In this paper, we present new methods for taxonomic classification, sex determination, and open-set re-identification from image sequences. We train and evaluate our models on a dataset of 35,914 photographs of 474 individual seahorses observed in the wild. We demonstrate that our approach, by combining information from multiple photographs, yields state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出面向野外海马图像序列的自动分类、性别判定和开集重识别方法，通过融合多张照片信息提升识别性能。
AI.motivation: 自动化动物重识别可支持非侵入式、大规模“捕获—标记—重捕获”研究，但单次观测会话中的照片质量差异大，单张图像常不足以支撑准确重识别，因此需要从图像序列中聚合信息以提高可靠性。
AI.method: 作者构建了包含35,914张野生海马照片、涉及474个个体的数据集，并训练评估用于分类、性别判定和开集重识别的模型；核心思想是结合同一观测序列中多张照片的信息进行个体识别与属性判断。
AI.result: 在基于多张照片序列的识别设置下，所提方法在分类、性别判定和开集重识别任务上取得了当前最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 利用图像序列中的互补信息能够显著改善低质量单帧带来的识别不确定性，支持面向野生种群的规模化、非侵入式个体识别研究。

title: M-PFT: Angular Margin for Calibrated Prompt-Tuning of Fine-Tuned Vision-Language Models
authors: Udaya Sampath K. Perera Miriya Thanthrige
summary: Prompt-tuning has emerged as a parameter-efficient technique for adapting large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) to downstream tasks while keeping the pre-trained weights frozen. However, prompt-tuned VLMs often suffer from a base-to-novel dual miscalibration problem, where models typically show underconfidence on base classes and overconfidence on novel classes. Current VLM calibration approaches address this dual miscalibration either separately or jointly, but lack a geometric understanding of the hyperspherical embedding space and thus fail to exploit angular discriminative properties to adjust distorted decision boundaries. To address this, we propose M-PFT, a novel angular-margin approach for prompt tuning that introduces two complementary objectives to promote class discriminability and semantic anchoring. This enlarges the angular margin by 1) minimizing the maximum cosine similarity between tunable class embeddings to reduce embedding collapse and 2) minimizing the angular distance between each tunable embedding and its corresponding zero-shot embedding to preserve semantic geometry. Extensive experiments across 9 prompt-tuning methods with various backbones on 15 diverse datasets show that our approach reduces the average calibration error on novel classes, while remaining competitive on base classes and maintaining comparable accuracy. Further analyses reveal that M-PFT effectively adjusts distorted decision boundaries induced by prompt tuning while preserving the pre-trained embedding space, improving calibration with negligible computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 M-PFT，一种面向视觉-语言模型提示微调的角度间隔优化方法，通过增强可训练类嵌入之间的角向判别性并锚定零样本语义几何，缓解基类欠置信与新类过置信的双失准问题。
AI.motivation: 提示微调能在冻结大规模视觉-语言模型预训练权重的前提下高效适配下游任务，但微调后的 VLM 常出现 base-to-novel 双向校准失准：基类欠置信、新类过置信。现有校准方法往往分别或联合处理这一问题，但缺乏对超球面嵌入空间的几何理解，未能利用角度判别性来修正被扰乱的决策边界。
AI.method: 提出 M-PFT，在提示微调中引入两个互补目标以扩大角度间隔：一是最大化最小可训练类嵌入间的最小角间隔，具体通过降低可训练类嵌入之间的最大余弦相似度来减少嵌入塌缩；二是语义锚定，即缩小每个可训练类嵌入与其对应零样本类嵌入之间的角度距离，以保留预训练语义几何。实验在 15 个数据集、9 种提示微调方法和不同骨干模型上验证。
AI.result: M-PFT 能降低新类上的平均校准误差，同时在基类上保持有竞争力的校准表现，并维持相近的准确率；分析表明该方法可有效修正提示微调造成的扭曲决策边界，同时保留预训练嵌入空间，额外计算开销极小。
AI.conclusion: M-PFT 将超球面嵌入空间的角度几何与提示微调校准问题结合，通过类判别性增强和零样本语义锚定双重约束，改善 VLM 在 base-to-novel 场景下的校准表现。该思路表明，校准不仅可通过概率或温度后处理实现，也可在嵌入几何层面直接约束提示微调过程。

title: Parametric Gaussian Noise Mixer (PGNM): Unified Synthesis of Camera Noise and Film Grain
summary: Noise synthesis is commonly approached through physical models of image formation or neural networks trained to generate noisy images. We explore a middle ground: an explicit statistical model fitted directly from paired clean and noisy images. A normalized convolution correlates a Gaussian field across pixels and color channels, and a lookup maps each Gaussian value to a residual given the clean intensity. Because the field stays standard Gaussian, the two components are fitted separately, without reproducing the physical process or training a neural generator. With one formulation for camera noise from SIDD and simulated film grain from Newson, the model has the lowest average distribution and correlation errors on SIDD among the evaluated methods and remains competitive on film grain. A denoiser trained on its noise comes closest to one trained on real noise, and a 1080p frame renders in 10 ms on GPU.
comment: Technical report. 49 pages: 9-page main paper and 40-page supplementary material; 29 figures, 33 tables

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种介于物理模型与神经网络生成器之间的显式统计噪声合成模型：用标准高斯场经归一化卷积跨像素和颜色通道相关，再通过基于清洁强度的查找表将高斯值映射为噪声残差，可高效拟合真实相机噪声与模拟胶片颗粒。
AI.motivation: 现有噪声合成方法通常依赖图像成像物理模型或训练神经网络生成噪声，分别存在物理建模复杂、数据或训练成本高等问题。作者希望探索一种可直接从成对的干净图像和噪声图像拟合的显式统计模型，在准确性、可解释性和生成效率之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 方法将噪声生成分解为两个可分别拟合的组件：首先构造一个标准高斯场，并通过归一化卷积在像素空间和颜色通道之间引入相关性；随后使用查找表，根据对应位置的干净图像强度将每个高斯值映射为噪声残差。由于高斯场始终保持标准分布，模型无需复现物理成像过程，也不需要训练神经生成器，同时可统一表示SIDD相机噪声和Newson模拟胶片颗粒。
AI.result: 在SIDD数据集上，该模型在所评估方法中具有最低的平均分布误差和相关性误差；在模拟胶片颗粒上仍保持竞争力。基于该模型生成噪声训练的降噪器，最接近在真实噪声上训练的降噪器效果，并且GPU上渲染一帧1080p图像仅需约10毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了一种简洁显式统计噪声合成模型的有效性：通过高斯场、归一化卷积和清洁强度条件查找表，可以高效且准确地拟合真实或模拟图像噪声，为降噪训练数据生成和噪声建模提供了无需复杂物理仿真或重型神经生成的实用方案。

title: What Survives Label Downsampling? Exact Region Survival for Coarse Segmentation Targets
summary: Segmentation networks that predict at an output stride are trained against label maps downsampled by strided sampling, nearest-neighbor resampling or majority pooling. These methods label each coarse grid cell on its own, so a region that wins no cell is absent from the target and receives no positive label. We present MatchDown, which builds the coarse target from a minimum-cost matching between regions and the grid cells they occupy. It keeps as many regions as any one-region-per-cell target can, certifies how many losses are unavoidable, and with priority tiers (MatchDown-P) keeps every evaluated region (a region that a metric scores) of at least one cell's area. On COCO, Cityscapes and BBBC038 at factors 2 to 16, MatchDown-P loses exactly the minimum number of regions, whereas the downsampling used by StarDist, nnU-Net and connectomics pyramids loses four to five times as many on COCO at factor 8. Keeping a region in the target and reconstructing its shape are different problems: we show that no region lost by majority pooling can be reconstructed above IoU 0.5 by upsampling any coarse target, yet on BBBC038 a star-convex head trained on MatchDown targets segments 35% of the nuclei that majority pooling loses above IoU 0.5, against 15% when trained on majority targets and 24% on StarDist's strided target. On two nucleus datasets, with thresholds cross-validated for count error, this head has instance accuracy at IoU 0.5 (Acc50) 2.6 to 4.2 points above the strided target and at most 2.8 points below cell-center sampling, and a lower count error than the strided and cell-center targets on BBBC039. On BBBC039, an affinity head, which outputs one label per cell, lowers count error relative to majority targets by 9.3 nuclei per image at 7.2 points lower Acc50. MatchDown runs once, before training, in place of the label-downsampling step.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MatchDown，用区域与粗网格单元之间的最小费用匹配来构造分割网络下采样后的标签目标，以尽可能少地丢失实例区域，并给出漏标区域不可避免数量的证书；其优先级版本 MatchDown-P 在 COCO、Cityscapes 和 BBBC038 上达到理论最小的区域丢失，并改善实例分割精度与计数误差。
AI.motivation: 分割网络常以较大输出步幅预测结果，训练标签需由原分辨率标签下采样到粗网格。传统方法如跨步采样、最近邻重采样或多数池化均独立决定每个粗网格单元的标签，因此若某个区域没有“赢得”任何粗网格单元，就会从目标标签中消失，训练时得不到正标签。这在实例分割、细胞核分割等任务中尤其严重，因为小区域或细薄区域容易被完全漏标，进而损害实例召回率、分割质量和计数误差。本文旨在解决“下采样后的目标如何尽量保留所有应被评价指标关注的区域”的问题。
AI.method: 作者提出 MatchDown，将粗尺度目标标签的构造建模为区域集合与其所占据的粗网格单元集合之间的最小费用匹配。相比每个粗网格单独选择胜者，MatchDown 通过全局匹配在“每个粗网格至多放置一个区域”的约束下最大化可保留区域数，并可给出不可避免漏标区域的数量证明。针对评价指标实际关注的区域，MatchDown-P 进一步引入优先级分层，确保所有被指标计入、且面积至少达到一个粗网格单元的评测区域都被保留。该方法仅需在训练前替代原本的标签下采样步骤。实验在 COCO、Cityscapes 和 BBBC038 上于下采样因子 2 到 16 进行，并使用星形凸头、亲和头、跨步标签、多数池化标签和细胞中心采样标签等进行实例分割与计数误差比较。
AI.result: MatchDown-P 在多个数据集和不同下采样因子下能够恰好保留任意“每格一个区域”目标所能保留的最大区域数量；而在 COCO 的 8 倍下采样下，StarDist、nnU-Net 和连接组学金字塔所采用的下采样方式丢失的区域数量是 MatchDown-P 的 4 到 5 倍。作者指出“在目标中保留区域”和“从粗目标重建区域形状”是不同问题：被多数池化丢失的区域即使上采样任意粗目标，也无法重建到 IoU 0.5；但在 BBBC038 上，使用 MatchDown 目标训练的星形凸头可分割 35% 的多数池化丢失细胞核并达到 IoU 0.5，高于多数池化目标的 15% 和 StarDist 跨步目标的 24%。在两个细胞核数据集上，以计数误差交叉验证阈值后，星形凸头的 IoU 0.5 实例精度比跨步目标高 2.6 到 4.2 点，最多比细胞中心采样低 2.8 点，并在 BBBC039 上计数误差低于跨步目标和细胞中心目标。BBBC039 上亲和头相比多数目标可将计数误差降低 9.3 个核/图像，但 Acc50 降低 7.2 点。
AI.conclusion: MatchDown 是一种训练前标签下采样替代方法，通过区域与粗网格单元的全局最小费用匹配显著减少实例区域在粗尺度目标中的丢失，并能给出最优保留和不可避免漏标的证书。实验表明它能在保持较高 Acc50 的同时改善实例计数误差，说明目标构造中的区域保真度对实例分割评估很重要。然而，保留区域并不等同于可精确重建区域形状，尤其对于严重下采后的粗标签，上采样仍无法恢复被彻底丢失的小区域。实际应用中需根据指标偏好权衡：星形凸头更利于在保留区域的同时提高实例精度，而亲和头可降低计数误差但可能牺牲部分 Acc50。

title: sDMD: Sinkhorn Distribution Matching Distillation
summary: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) distills multi-step diffusion models into few-step generators by minimizing reverse KL divergence. Despite its strong performance, DMD guides samples by local density alone, which introduces two limitations: teacher scores can be unreliable in regions of low teacher density, and the mode-seeking behavior of reverse KL can collapse the student onto a subset of the teacher modes. We first connect DMD to Wasserstein gradient flow, showing that its gradient follows from a fixed-point formulation with integral KL (IKL) as the energy functional. This perspective motivates augmenting IKL with an optimal transport term that addresses these limitations by guiding outlier samples toward the target and promoting mode coverage. We realize this term using Sinkhorn divergence estimated from finite batches. In practice, however, errors in the estimated Sinkhorn velocity can perturb in-domain samples for which IKL guidance is already accurate. To this end, we introduce sDMD, which adaptively activates the Sinkhorn correction based on discriminator outputs, focusing on outlier samples where IKL may be unreliable. With 2--4 sampling steps on FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image-20B, and Wan2.1-14B, sDMD outperforms distillation baselines on GenEval, DPG, WISE, and VBench while improving sample diversity over DMD2.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 sDMD，在 Distribution Matching Distillation（DMD）的 reverse-KL / integral KL 蒸馏框架中引入自适应的 Sinkhorn 最优传输修正，以缓解低教师密度区域评分不可靠和模式坍塌问题，并在图像/视频生成中提升少步生成质量与多样性。
AI.motivation: DMD 仅依赖局部密度引导样本，导致两个问题：教师在低密度区域给出的 score 可能不可靠；reverse KL 的模式寻找行为会使学生模型坍缩到教师分布的少数模式上，降低生成多样性。
AI.method: 首先将 DMD 解释为 Wasserstein gradient flow，指出其梯度来自以 integral KL（IKL）为能量泛函的不动点形式。随后在 IKL 上增加一个基于 Sinkhorn divergence 的最优传输项，用有限 batch 估计传输速度，以引导离群样本并促进模式覆盖。为避免估计误差扰动本已被 IKL 正确引导的域内样本，sDMD 利用判别器输出自适应决定是否启用 Sinkhorn 修正，主要作用于 IKL 可能不可靠的离群样本。
AI.result: 在 FLUX.1-dev、Qwen-Image-20B 和 Wan2.1-14B 上，使用 2–4 步采样时，sDMD 在 GenEval、DPG、WISE 和 VBench 上优于现有蒸馏基线，并相比 DMD2 提升了样本多样性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将 DMD 与 Wasserstein 梯度流和 integral KL 联系起来，并引入自适应、判别器门控的 Sinkhorn 最优传输修正，sDMD 能够在少步蒸馏生成中兼顾教师密度低区域的鲁棒性、模式覆盖和生成质量。

title: TokenRepel: Generating Diverse Image Sets Without Compromising Quality
summary: We present an inference-time approach that enhances the visual diversity of image sets generated by text-to-image models, without compromising the average image quality. Our method leverages the intrinsic geometry of hidden representations in pretrained models to diversify images generated from the same prompt. First, we introduce a token repulsion mechanism that increases the angle between feature tokens across samples. It takes a negative Riemannian gradient step on a von Mises-Fisher mixture distribution of tokens on the unit hypersphere. Second, to preserve the quality of each output image, we propose a token density preservation mechanism that projects the repulsion-induced prediction change onto a half-space aligned with the model's score direction. This encourages the updates to remain within the high-density regions learned by the generative model. We further extend this mechanism to the output of each intermediate layer, enabling finer-grained iterative guidance. We evaluate our method on three types of pretrained text-to-image models. Experiments show substantial gains in visual diversity under identical prompts, while maintaining a comparable level of image fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种推理阶段的方法，利用预训练文生图模型隐藏表征的内在几何来增强同一提示词生成图像集的视觉多样性，同时基本保持图像质量。其核心是通过 token 排斥机制扩大跨样本特征表示的角度，并用 token 密度保持机制将更新限制在模型生成分布的高密度区域。
AI.motivation: 文生图模型在给定相同提示词时，往往可能生成视觉内容较为相似的图片，缺乏多样性。已有方法若强行增加多样性，可能会破坏生成质量或需要额外训练。因此，作者希望在不修改模型权重、不牺牲平均图像保真度的前提下，从推理过程中挖掘模型隐层表示的几何结构，实现更有效的视觉多样性增强。
AI.method: 方法包括两个关键机制。第一是 token 排斥机制：将预训练模型中的特征 token 视为单位超球面上的点，在 von Mises-Fisher 混合分布上对跨样本 token 采取负黎曼梯度步，增大不同样本 token 特征之间的角度，从而推动生成结果多样化。第二是 token 密度保持机制：将排斥带来的预测变化投影到与模型得分方向对齐的半空间中，使更新尽量停留在模型学到的数据高密度区域，避免生成低质量图像。该机制还被扩展到中间层输出，以实现更细粒度的迭代引导。
AI.result: 在三种预训练文生图模型上进行了实验。结果显示，该方法在相同提示词条件下显著提升生成图像集的视觉多样性，同时保持与原始方法相当或相近的图像保真度/平均质量，说明多样性增强并未明显损害生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用预训练生成模型隐藏表示的几何结构，可以在推理阶段实现对文生图模型生成多样性的有效控制。token 排斥提供多样性方向，密度保持则约束更新不偏离高质量生成区域。该方法无需重新训练，具有推理时增强生成多样性的潜力。

title: PhysAg3D: Bridging 3D Generative and Agentic Models for High-Fidelity and Physically-Interactive Assets
summary: Generating interactive 3D assets from a single image requires realistic appearance, fidelity to the depicted object, and plausible physical behavior. Yet detailed geometry alone does not determine how an object should move or deform. We introduce PhysAg3D, which couples 3D generative models with agentic reasoning and tool use. A vision-language agent first infers semantic parts, candidate interactions, and physical priors from the image; a 3D generator then produces a textured whole-object mesh from the same image. A hierarchical interaction representation links these revisable priors to mechanisms and the generated surfaces they control, organizing interaction construction and refinement. Guided by this representation and observations of the mesh, the agent uses geometric and physical tools to construct parts, joints, deformable regions, and surface bindings while retaining useful generated geometry and materials. Rendered interactions and execution measurements guide targeted revisions within a fixed budget. The framework accommodates both rigid articulation and compliant deformation. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on real photographs and external benchmarks demonstrate detailed, image-aligned assets with plausible interactions. Ablations support bounded refinement and source-surface preservation. Project Page: this http URL.

AI.tldr: PhysAg3D 提出一个从单张图像生成交互式 3D 资产的框架，通过将视觉语言智能体、物理先验推理与 3D 生成模型结合，使生成的网格不仅外观真实，还具备符合物体语义和物理规律的刚体关节运动或柔性形变能力。
AI.motivation: 仅凭单张图像生成高质量几何并不足以确定物体应如何运动或形变。交互式 3D 资产需要同时满足外观真实性、对图像中物体的忠实还原以及可信的物理行为，但现有方法难以自动建立语义部件、交互机制与生成表面之间的联系。
AI.method: 该方法首先由视觉语言智能体从输入图像中推断语义部件、候选交互方式和物理先验，同时由 3D 生成模型生成同一图像的带纹理完整物体网格。随后使用层次化交互表征，将可修正的物理/语义先验与运动机制及其控制的生成表面相关联。智能体在该表征指导下，利用几何和物理工具构建部件、关节、可形变区域和表面绑定，并尽量保留原始生成几何与材质。最后通过渲染交互效果和执行测量结果，在固定预算内进行定向修正，支持刚体关节运动和柔性形变两类交互。
AI.result: 在真实照片和外部基准上的定量与定性实验表明，PhysAg3D 能够生成细节丰富、与图像对齐且具有可信交互行为的 3D 资产。消融实验进一步验证了有限预算的迭代修正机制和源表面保持策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PhysAg3D 通过把生成式 3D 建模与智能体工具使用相结合，为从单图构建具备合理物理行为的交互式 3D 资产提供了一种可行框架，尤其适用于需要同时保持视觉保真度和交互合理性的应用。

title: Spectral Invariant Fusion and Refinement for Domain Generalized Semantic Segmentation
summary: Domain generalized semantic segmentation is challenging because it requires accurate dense prediction on unseen domains without any access to target-domain data during training. Existing methods improve transferability through data diversification, invariant learning, or direct use of foundation models, but they often struggle to simultaneously suppress domain-sensitive interference and preserve fine-grained spatial cues. In this work, we propose SIFR, a frequency-aware dual-stream framework that tackles domain shift at both the fusion and decoding stages. SIFR uses spectral modeling as a unified principle to regulate both heterogeneous prior interaction and dense decoder refinement. Instead of directly fusing frozen CLIP and DINOv2 features, SIFR performs spectral-guided invariant fusion to filter out domain-sensitive responses while preserving complementary semantic and structural information. In addition, SIFR incorporates a spectral decoder refinement module that stabilizes multi-scale decoder features through low-frequency statistics-based normalization and adaptive frequency selection, thereby reducing the propagation of residual domain bias in dense prediction. This design enables SIFR to jointly improve domain robustness and segmentation precision under severe distribution shifts. Extensive experiments on multiple DGSS benchmarks, including synthetic-to-real, real-to-real, and adverse-weather settings, demonstrate consistent improvements over previous state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SIFR，一种频域感知的双流框架，通过频域建模统一调控CLIP/DINOv2先验融合与解码器密集预测过程，以提升域泛化语义分割的鲁棒性和精细分割精度。
AI.motivation: 域泛化语义分割要求模型在无目标域数据的情况下对未见域进行准确密集预测。现有方法虽通过数据多样化、不变学习或直接利用基础模型提升跨域迁移能力，但往往难以同时抑制域敏感干扰并保留细粒度空间线索。
AI.method: SIFR采用频率感知的双流设计，在融合和解码两个阶段缓解域偏移。其核心是以频谱建模作为统一原则：一方面，不进行简单融合冻结CLIP与DINOv2特征，而是提出频谱引导的不变融合模块，过滤域敏感响应并保留互补语义与结构信息；另一方面，提出频谱解码器精化模块，通过基于低频统计信息的归一化和自适应频率选择稳定多尺度解码特征，减少残余域偏差在密集预测中的传播。
AI.result: 在多个域泛化语义分割基准上，包括合成到真实、真实到真实以及恶劣天气设置，实验表明SIFR相较现有最优方法取得持续改进，能够在严重分布偏移下同时提升域鲁棒性和分割精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过将频域建模引入先验融合与解码精化两个关键阶段，SIFR有效协调域不变性与空间细节保持，为域泛化语义分割提供了一种兼顾鲁棒性和精度改进的有效框架。

title: MLLM-GS: Multimodal Large Language Model Prior-Guided Fast Novel View Synthesis in Extreme Environments
summary: Novel view synthesis (NVS) in degraded scenes aims to reconstruct 3D scenes from multi-view observations affected by various degradations, and to generate clear and photorealistic images at unseen viewpoints. Despite recent advances, existing methods often rely on degradation-specific models, limiting their generalization across diverse extreme environments. Generative models provide rich visual priors, but their outputs often suffer from pixel misalignment and color deviations, which can propagate into the reconstructed 3D scene and compromise reconstruction quality. Furthermore, the high computational and memory costs of 3D reconstruction hinder the practical application of NVS in extreme environments. To this end, we propose MLLM-GS, a multimodal large language model (MLLM) prior-guided framework for fast NVS in extreme environments. MLLM-GS consists of two branches: MLLM prior-guided view enhancement and fast 3D scene reconstruction. The former leverages the rich visual priors of a frozen MLLM to enhance views under different severe degradations and introduces a lightweight correction network to reduce pixel shifts and color distortions in MLLM outputs. With supervision from only a few paired clean views, this branch produces reliable enhanced views for all degraded observations, providing pseudo-GT views for subsequent 3D reconstruction. The latter improves 3DGS efficiency by optimizing rasterization, Gaussian memory layout, and parameter updates, reducing redundant computation, memory-access overhead, and optimization costs. Extensive experiments on multiple degraded scenes demonstrate that MLLM-GS effectively handles various severe degradations and achieves high-quality NVS with significantly lower reconstruction time and memory consumption. Project Page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 MLLM-GS，一种面向退化场景的快速新视角合成框架：利用冻结的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）先验增强退化图像，并通过轻量校正网络缓解像素偏移与色彩偏差；同时优化三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）的渲染、内存布局与参数更新，实现更高质量且更低时间/显存消耗的重建。
AI.motivation: 现有退化场景下的 Novel View Synthesis（NVS）方法通常依赖针对特定退化类型的模型，难以在多种极端环境中泛化；生成模型虽能提供丰富视觉先验，但容易引入像素不对齐和颜色偏差，并进一步损害三维重建质量。此外，三维重建高昂的计算与显存开销也限制了 NVS 在极端场景中的实际应用。
AI.method: MLLM-GS 包含两个分支：1）MLLM 先验引导的视角增强分支，利用冻结的 MLLM 对严重退化观测进行图像增强，并引入轻量校正网络修正输出中的像素偏移与色彩失真；该分支仅需少量成对干净视角进行监督，即可为所有退化观测生成可信增强图像，作为后续三维重建的伪真值。2）快速三维场景重建分支，在 3DGS 基础上优化光栅化过程、高斯内存布局和参数更新策略，以减少冗余计算、内存访问开销和优化成本。
AI.result: 在多个退化场景上的大量实验表明，MLLM-GS 能有效处理多种严重退化条件，获得高质量新视角合成结果，并显著降低三维重建的时间和显存消耗。
AI.conclusion: MLLM-GS 通过结合 MLLM 视觉先验与高效 3DGS 优化，为极端退化场景提供了一种兼顾鲁棒性、重建质量和实用效率的快速 NVS 框架。

title: BiHashFormer: Hash-Driven Dual-Branch Transformer for Efficient Object Detection in HRW Shots
summary: Recent advances in gigapixel-level imaging have brought High-Resolution Wide shots to the forefront of research. However, these images present significant challenges: extreme sparsity of foreground, gigapixel-level resolutions and interleaving of foreground and background. This causes traditional detectors and attention mechanisms to be hindered by background, resulting in inefficiency and inaccuracy. To tackle this problem, we propose BiHashFormer, a dual sparsified branch transformer built on hashing. RoI Selector will predict the foreground proportion for top-k selecting target-containing windows. The compression branch processes windows selected and refines attention into HashAttention by discarding half of the key-value pairs, reducing cost and improving efficiency. The compensation branch uses HashMiner to perform low-cost hash searches in the remaining regions, recovering features of missed objects. Experiments confirm that the selection relationship in HashAttention is one-way and reveal the preference of different queries for keys. In experiments on the gigapixel benchmark PANDA, BiHashFormer reduces 37.5% backbone FLOPs while improving AP50 to 81.0%. Moreover, this parallel dual-branch structure allows the model to avoid inference delays caused by inter-branch dependencies, while achieving much greater stability than single-branch models, specially with low rates of RoI selection.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 34 pages including supplementary material and the NeurIPS checklist. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 BiHashFormer，一种基于哈希的双稀疏分支 Transformer，用于 gigapixel 高分辨率广角图像目标检测，通过 RoI 选择、压缩分支和补偿分支显著降低计算成本并提升精度。
AI.motivation: Gigapixel 级高分辨率图像中前景极度稀疏、分辨率极大且前景与背景交错，传统检测器和注意力机制易受背景干扰，导致效率低和精度不足。
AI.method: 提出双稀疏分支 Transformer：RoI Selector 预测前景比例并选择 top-k 目标窗口；压缩分支通过 HashAttention 丢弃一半键值对以降低代价；补偿分支通过 HashMiner 在剩余区域进行低成本哈希检索，恢复漏检目标特征。
AI.result: 实验证实 HashAttention 中筛选关系具有方向性，并揭示不同 query 对 key 的偏好。在 PANDA gigapixel 基准上，BiHashFormer 将主干网络 FLOPs 降低 37.5%，同时将 AP50 提升至 81.0%。
AI.conclusion: 并行双分支结构避免分支依赖导致的推理延迟，并在低 RoI 选择率下表现出比单分支模型更强的稳定性。

title: ElasticFormer: Detecting Objects in HRW Shots via Elastic Computing Vision Transformer
summary: Recent advances in gigapixel-level imaging have brought High-Resolution Wide shots to the forefront of research. However, these images present significant challenges: extreme sparsity of foreground, gigapixel-level resolutions and diverse target counts. This makes traditional close-up detectors inaccurate and slow as they are overwhelmed by the background. Although previous research has explored sparse backbones, their fixed sparsity patterns lack the adaptability required to handle diverse target numbers. To address this, we introduce ElasticFormer, a sparse backbone that dynamically allocates computational resources based on foreground proportion. After scoring windows based on variance, proposed ElasticSelector module will predict the foreground proportion for top-k selection. The mechanism guides the model to select target-containing windows, scaling resources in areas where objects are clustered. We introduce a novel loss function combined with the 3-phase training strategy for ElasticSelector, allowing it to function properly when bounding box annotations are missing. A WSOD study is carried on PASCAL VOC 2007 to evaluate its extensibility. Further, ElasticNet is created to verify its backbone-agnostic nature. In experiments on the PANDA gigapixel benchmark, ElasticFormer reduces backbone FLOPs by 80% while achieving a significant improvement in AP50 when compared to fixed-ratio sparse methods.
comment: Published at CVPR 2026. 14 pages including supplementary material. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出ElasticFormer：一种弹性稀疏骨干网络，能够根据前景比例动态分配计算资源，用于高效高分辨率宽景图像目标检测。
AI.motivation: 吉像素级高分辨率宽景图像具有前景极度稀疏、分辨率极高、目标数量差异大等特点，传统近景检测器易被背景淹没且速度慢；现有稀疏骨干依赖固定稀疏比例，难以适应不同场景中的目标密度变化。
AI.method: 作者提出ElasticSelector模块：先基于方差对图像窗口评分，再预测前景比例并据此进行top-k窗口选择，使模型聚焦包含目标的区域并在目标聚集处扩展计算资源。为支持缺少边界框标注的训练，进一步提出新的损失函数和三阶段训练策略。还引入ElasticNet验证其骨干无关性，并在PASCAL VOC 2007上开展弱监督目标检测实验评估扩展性。
AI.result: 在PANDA吉像素基准上，ElasticFormer相比固定比例稀疏方法可将骨干网络FLOPs降低80%，同时显著提升AP50；在PASCAL VOC 2007的弱监督目标检测研究中也显示出较好的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: ElasticFormer通过前景比例感知的动态稀疏计算替代固定稀疏模式，为高分辨率宽景目标检测提供了低成本、强适应性且可支持弱监督训练的骨干网络方案。

title: UniRA: Unified Representation Alignment and Auto-Encoding for Efficient Diffusion Generation
summary: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) have become the dominant architecture for high-fidelity image synthesis, yet they suffer from slow training convergence and high computational cost. Two recent lines of work address this from complementary angles: Representation Alignment (REPA) accelerates DiT training by aligning intermediate features with a pretrained external representation model (e.g., DINOv2), while Representation Auto-Encoders (RAE) replace the pixel-space VAE with a compact representation-space tokenizer learned from self-supervised features. However, these approaches are developed and applied in isolation: REPA still relies on a pixel-space VAE for latent diffusion, and RAE does not exploit the alignment signal that accelerates the diffusion backbone. We present \textbf{UniRA}, a unified framework that couples representation alignment and representation auto-encoding into a single objective. UniRA learns a representation-space tokenizer whose output serves simultaneously as the diffusion target and the alignment anchor, so the tokenizer, the diffusion backbone, and the external representation model are co-optimized. We give a theoretical result showing that this joint optimization preserves the representation quality of the external model while accelerating diffusion convergence, and we derive a principled weighting that balances the reconstruction, alignment, and generation objectives. On ImageNet class-conditional generation at 256*256 and 512*512, UniRA matches or surpasses state-of-the-art DiTs (SD3, REPA, RAE) in FID while reducing training steps by up to 5*. We further show that the unified representation space supports improved zero-shot classification and linear probing, confirming that generation and understanding benefit from a shared, aligned latent space.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出UniRA，将表示对齐（REPA）与表示自编码器（RAE）统一到一个训练目标中，使表示空间tokenizer同时作为扩散生成目标和对齐锚点，从而加速DiT训练、降低计算成本，并提升图像生成与表示理解能力。
AI.motivation: Diffusion Transformer（DiT）在高保真图像生成中表现优异，但训练收敛慢、计算开销大。REPA可通过与外部预训练表示模型对齐来加速DiT训练，但仍依赖像素空间VAE进行潜在扩散；RAE利用自监督特征学习表示空间tokenizer以替代VAE，却未充分利用对齐信号来加速扩散主干。二者孤立发展，未能形成统一、互补的训练框架。
AI.method: UniRA提出统一框架，联合优化表示对齐和表示自编码。模型学习一个表示空间tokenizer，其输出同时用于扩散生成目标和对齐锚点，使tokenizer、DiT扩散主干以及外部表示模型（如DINOv2）协同优化。论文进一步给出理论结果，说明联合优化可在保留外部模型表示质量的同时加速扩散收敛，并推导用于平衡重建、对齐和生成三个目标的加权策略。
AI.result: 在ImageNet类条件图像生成任务上，UniRA在256×256和512×512分辨率下达到或超过现有先进DiT方法（包括SD3、REPA和RAE）的FID表现，同时可将训练步数最多减少5倍。此外，UniRA所学习的统一表示空间还支持更好的零样本分类和线性探针性能，说明共享且对齐的潜在空间能够同时促进生成和理解任务。
AI.conclusion: UniRA表明，将表示对齐与表示自编码统一到同一目标中，可以缓解DiT训练收敛慢和计算成本高的问题，并构建一个兼顾生成质量、训练效率和语义表示能力的共享潜在空间。生成和理解任务能够从统一的对齐表示空间中共同受益。

title: EPC-RawDC: Equivariant Physics Constrained 3D Diffusion with Raw Data Consistency for CBCT to CT Image Synthesis
summary: Cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used for image guided and adaptive radiotherapy, but scatter, noise, reconstruction artifacts, and inaccurate Hounsfield units limit its quantitative use. Recent diffusion approaches for CBCT to CT synthesis remain largely image driven, with limited use of the underlying acquisition physics. We propose EPC-RawDC, a conditional 3D latent diffusion framework that combines volumetric generative modeling with two complementary constraints derived from the same scanner specific CBCT forward model. First, geometry equivariant projection constraint exploits the rotational equivariance of the CBCT forward operator by supervising the synthesized CT through correspondingly transformed reference projections. Second, raw data consistency uses noisy projection measurements of the individual acquisition as scan specific supervision during training. The framework was evaluated on two independent clinical cohorts with distinct scanner geometries and projection sources. For JUST, the physics constraints used measured clinical raw CBCT projections acquired with an Elekta system, whereas for SynthRAD2025 the projection data were simulated from the reference CT using a Varian geometry with Poisson photon statistics. EPC-RawDC achieved an SSIM of 0.97 in both cohorts and improved PSNR over DDPM by 2.66 dB on SynthRAD2025 and 2.10 dB on JUST, while reducing mean MAE by 20.3% and 19.0%, respectively. On SynthRAD2025, projection consistency and equivariant errors were reduced by 55.0% and 41.4% relative to DDPM. These results demonstrate that combining a volumetric diffusion prior with scanner geometry and scan specific projection measurements improves quantitative CBCT to CT synthesis across both simulated and measured projection domains. Code available after publication at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出EPC-RawDC，将3D潜空间扩散模型与CBCT正向物理模型结合，通过几何等变投影约束和原始数据一致性约束提升CBCT到CT的定量合成性能，并在两个临床数据集上验证有效。
AI.motivation: CBCT广泛用于影像引导和自适应放疗，但其散射、噪声、重建伪影以及不准确的Hounsfield Unit使其难以直接用于剂量计算和定量应用。现有CBCT到CT合成扩散方法多以图像驱动，较少利用采集物理和投影数据，定量改进有限。
AI.method: 提出条件式3D潜空间扩散框架EPC-RawDC。该框架以同一扫描仪特定的CBCT正向模型为约束来源，包含两项互补机制：一是几何等变投影约束，利用CBCT正向算子的旋转等变性，通过相应变换后的参考投影监督合成CT；二是原始数据一致性约束，利用个体采集的含噪投影测量值作为扫描仪特定训练监督。
AI.result: 在JUST和SynthRAD2025两个具有不同扫描仪几何结构和投影来源的独立临床队列上评估。EPC-RawDC在两个队列中均达到0.97 SSIM；相较DDPM，在SynthRAD2025上PSNR提升2.66 dB，在JUST上提升2.10 dB；平均MAE分别降低20.3%和19.0%。在SynthRAD2025上，投影一致性误差和等变误差分别降低55.0%和41.4%。
AI.conclusion: 将体积扩散先验与扫描仪几何及扫描特定投影测量相结合，可显著改善定量CBCT到CT合成，并在模拟投影域和实测投影域中均有效，说明基于物理约束的生成模型优于单纯图像驱动方法。

title: Localizing Concepts in Visual Autoregressive Models
summary: Understanding the internal routing of visual concepts is crucial for the safe and controllable adaptation of generative models. While concept localization has been widely studied in diffusion models, the emerging paradigm of next-scale visual autoregressive models remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce LoCo, the first model-agnostic framework to localize where and when specific concepts emerge within autoregressive models. Driven by the native coarse-to-fine nature of next-scale generation, our method precisely maps conceptual knowledge across three distinct dimensions: Layer, Scale, and Position. To systematically localize and evaluate concept routing without context bias, we propose LoCoBench, a comprehensive dataset spanning 10 diverse categories. Extensive probing on image and video autoregressive models like Infinity, HunyuanImage-3.0, and InfinityStar shows that the localized positions are both interpretable and causally related to concept emergence. Building on these insights, we apply our localization method to three key applications: concept erasure, model personalization, and adversarial concept injection. Experiments demonstrate that our targeted intervention achieves state-of-the-art performance, substantially reducing computational overhead while preserving benign utility. Overall, our findings offer insights into how conceptual knowledge is routed during autoregressive generation, introducing a practical pathway for more interpretable, efficient, and secure adaptation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LoCo，一种面向视觉自回归生成模型的通用概念定位框架，可在层级、尺度和位置维度上识别概念何时何地涌现，并应用于概念擦除、个性化和对抗注入等干预任务。
AI.motivation: 生成模型中视觉概念的内部路由机制对安全可控适配至关重要，但现有概念定位研究主要面向扩散模型，新兴的next-scale视觉自回归模型仍缺乏系统探索。由于此类模型具有由粗到细的生成过程，需要理解概念知识在不同层、尺度和位置上的分布及其因果作用。
AI.method: 论文提出LoCo框架，在层（Layer）、尺度（Scale）和位置（Position）三个维度定位概念在自回归生成中的出现；同时构建LoCoBench数据集，涵盖10类概念，用于在无上下文偏置条件下系统评估概念路由。方法应用于Infinity、HunyuanImage-3.0和InfinityStar等图像与视频自回归模型，并通过概念擦除、模型个性化和对抗性概念注入验证定位有效性。
AI.result: 实验表明，LoCo定位到的层级、尺度和位置具有可解释性，并与概念涌现存在因果关系。基于该定位信息进行针对性干预，可在概念擦除、个性化和对抗注入任务中取得领先性能，同时显著降低计算开销并保持模型的正常可用能力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了视觉概念在自回归生成过程中的内部路由规律，提供了从概念定位到可控干预的统一框架，为更可解释、高效且安全的生成模型适配与治理提供了实际路径。

title: SelfThinker: Self-Evolving Reasoning via Reliability-Verified Intrinsic Visual Thoughts
summary: Unified multimodal models can both generate and understand images within a single set of weights, offering an opportunity to use image synthesis as training supervision for visual comprehension. However, existing visual chain-of-thought methods rely on human-annotated helper images during training and require slow image generation at test time. We present SelfThinker, the first self-evolving framework that turns a unified model's self-generated visual thoughts into stronger understanding without human image annotations. Given a visual problem, SelfThinker samples candidate helper images from its generation pathway and uses its frozen understanding pathway to score each candidate via conditional pointwise mutual information. High-utility visual thoughts then refine the generator via flow matching and serve as privileged teacher context for on-policy self-distillation. At inference, SelfThinker reasons directly from the original image in text without generating intermediate images. Although trained only on small synthetic visual-search and navigation datasets, SelfThinker transfers broadly to natural-image and spatial benchmarks, raising the seven-benchmark average of ThinkMorph-7B from 52.7 to 64.0 (+11.3 points). Controlled image-perturbation probes further show that SelfThinker surpasses ThinkMorph-7B by up to 40.4 points and its pretrained BAGEL-7B backbone by up to 23.2 points across fine-grained and spatial perception tasks. Our code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SelfThinker：一种自进化统一多模态框架，利用模型自身生成的视觉思考图像作为训练监督来提升图像理解能力，无需人工标注辅助图像；推理时仅从原图进行文本推理，不再额外生成图像。该方法在小规模合成数据上训练后，可显著迁移到自然图像与空间理解任务，并使 ThinkMorph-7B 的七项基准平均分提升 11.3 分。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型同时具备图像生成与图像理解能力，理论上可用图像合成结果反哺视觉理解训练。但已有视觉思维链方法通常依赖人工标注的辅助图像，且推理阶段需要额外生成图像，导致训练成本高、推理延迟大。本文希望构建一种自进化机制，让模型自行生成、评估并利用有价值的视觉思考，从而在无外部图像标注和低推理开销条件下提升视觉理解性能。
AI.method: SelfThinker 首先给定视觉问题，从统一模型的生成路径采样候选辅助图像；随后冻结理解路径，利用条件点互信息对候选图像进行评分，以判断其对原视觉问题的理解增益。高分视觉思考通过流匹配优化生成器，并作为特权教师上下文用于在策略自蒸馏。推理时不再生成中间图像，而是直接从原始图像进行文本化推理。
AI.result: 尽管仅在小型合成的视觉搜索与导航数据集上训练，SelfThinker 仍能广泛迁移到自然图像和空间理解基准。实验显示，ThinkMorph-7B 在七项基准上的平均分从 52.7 提升到 64.0，增益为 11.3 分。受控图像扰动探测进一步表明，SelfThinker 在细粒度感知和空间感知任务上较 ThinkMorph-7B 最高提升 40.4 分，较预训练主干 BAGEL-7B 最高提升 23.2 分。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了自生成视觉思考可作为有效训练信号，用于提升统一多模态模型的视觉理解能力。SelfThinker 的核心贡献在于去除人工辅助图像标注、降低推理阶段生成开销，并通过自评分、生成器优化和自蒸馏形成训练闭环。其在小规模合成任务上的结果显示出较强泛化能力，但整体性能仍依赖候选图像质量评分、自蒸馏有效性以及跨域迁移的稳定性。

title: SynthFaces: Balanced Large Scale Human Dataset
summary: The pursuit of fair and equitable AI in human-centric tasks is critically hindered by the inherent biases and privacy risks of real-world datasets, which offer imbalanced representations of identity and often contain sensitive personal information. Consequently, state-of-the-art generative models trained on this skewed data exhibit unfair performance, particularly in identity-preserving generation. In this work we propose a pipeline for controllable generation of dataset with diverse faces for generative models training and finetuning. We achieve this by expanding foundational Arc2Face diffusion model with a flow matching generative model in the manifold of identity embeddings. We demonstrate that such approach achieves both goals of generative fidelity and label diversity not present in real human-centric datasets. As a result we collect and further contextualize a highly balanced identity-centric dataset of humans named SynthFaces. By design, our released images and identities are synthetic, reducing direct reliance on real personal images; we empirically check identity separation with a nearest-neighbor non-leakage metric. We purpose it for training and tuning of fair models for various downstream tasks, and showcase its usability in finetuning an existing adapter-based method for personalized generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一条可控合成人脸数据集生成流水线，用于生成身份多样、隐私友好的训练/微调数据，以支持公平的身份保持生成模型；其核心是在 Arc2Face 身份嵌入流形上引入流匹配模型，构建 SynthFaces 数据集。
AI.motivation: 真实人本任务数据集常存在身份分布不均衡和隐私敏感信息问题，导致在其上训练的生成模型在身份保持生成等任务中表现不公平。
AI.method: 在基础 Arc2Face 扩散模型之外，引入流匹配生成模型来扩展身份嵌入流形，实现可控生成多样合成人脸；随后收集并整理高度均衡的身份中心数据集 SynthFaces，并用最近邻非泄露指标检验身份分离。
AI.result: 该方法同时实现了较高生成保真度与标签多样性，得到设计上合成、隐私风险更低的人脸数据集 SynthFaces；可用于公平下游模型训练，并演示了其对现有基于适配器的个性化生成方法微调的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，基于流匹配扩展身份嵌入流形的合成数据生成流水线可作为构建公平、可控、隐私友好人脸数据集的可行途径，有助于减少真实敏感数据依赖并改进身份保持生成与个性化生成。

title: It Takes Two to Probe, Thousands to Retrieve: Putting Vision--Language Probes to the Retrieval Test
summary: Vision--language models (VLMs) are tested for fine-grained understanding with image--text matching probes, a model must prefer the correct image or caption over handcrafted negative. In retrieval, the correct item must beat thousands of alternatives. We measure how these two evaluation methods relate by using two probing benchmarks, \svo{} and SugarCrepe, for retrieval tasks. For 100 image and caption queries we judge the top-10 retrievals from full dataset of six VLMs, with human annotators and an LLM assessor. We than compare how well models rank pool of items on the same queries, while changing only where the negatives comes from: the benchmark, a random draw, or the judged-incorrect retrievals of other models. On \svo{} the accuracy of retrieving a positive over handcrafted negatives is significantly higher than for retrieved ones (the correct item is preferred in 85\% against 77\% of the time). Using pool of ten retrieved negatives leads to same accuracy as when one uses pool of 200 to 430 random negatives. On SugarCrepe the order is reversed: its handcrafted negatives are harder than the retrieved ones. Incomplete relevance labels explain most of the low retrieval scores on \svo{}, where the top-ranked item is correct for 54--90\% of the queries under human labels against 6--21\% under the benchmark's labels. However, we detect no association between passing the probe for a query and retrieving a correct item first. The LLM assessor o3 agrees with individual annotators ($\kappa$ 0.57--0.61) slightly less than they agree with each other (0.64--0.68).

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉—语言模型（VLM）在细粒度图像—文本匹配探针与全库检索能力之间的差距：匹配探针通常只需在少量人工负例中选出正确图像或文本，而检索需要在大量候选中胜出。作者用 \svo{} 和 SugarCrepe 两个探针基准进行检索任务评估，发现探针成绩并不等价于检索成绩，负例来源、负例数量和标签完整性会显著影响模型表现。
AI.motivation: 视觉—语言模型常在图像—文本匹配任务上被测试其细粒度理解能力：模型需要在正确图像/文本与人工构造负例之间做出偏好判断。然而真实检索任务要求模型从全库成千上万个候选中排对目标项，因此“匹配探针通过”是否能反映“检索能力强”并不明确。本文旨在揭示两种评估方式之间的关系，并分析负例难度、检索候选来源和标注不完整如何改变模型表现。
AI.method: 作者选取六个 VLM，在 \svo{} 和 SugarCrepe 上对 100 条图像查询和文本查询进行全库检索，人工判断 Top-10 检索结果是否相关，并使用 LLM 评估者 o3 进行辅助判断。随后，他们比较模型在不同候选池上的排序表现：负例分别来自基准手工负例、随机负例，以及其他模型被人工判定为错误的检索结果。这样只改变负例来源，从而考察匹配探针与检索评估是否一致。
AI.result: 在 \svo{} 上，模型正确项优于手工负例的准确率为 85%，而优于“其他模型错误检索负例”的准确率只有 77%，说明后者更难；使用 10 个检索得到的负例即可达到 200—430 个随机负例相似的排序难度。SugarCrepe 上顺序相反，其手工负例比检索负例更难。 \svo{} 的低检索分数主要由不完整相关性标签解释：人工标注下 Top-1 正确的查询比例为 54%—90%，而使用基准标签时仅为 6%—21%。此外，未发现“通过查询级匹配探针”与“检索首位正确”之间存在关联。LLM 评估者 o3 与单个标注者的一致性为 κ=0.57—0.61，略低于标注者之间的 0.64—0.68。
AI.conclusion: 图像—文本匹配探针不能直接代表 VLM 的真实检索能力；两者在负例规模、负例来源和标注完整性方面存在系统性差异。未来评测需要区分“偏好正确项胜过少量人工负例”和“在全库检索中把正确项排到最前”，并应补充检索式负例、人工或 LLM 辅助重标注，以减少不完整标签造成的误导。

title: Hierarchical Step Decomposition for Training-free Online Video Step Grounding
summary: Given a set of procedural steps, Video Step Grounding (VSG) aims to identify which steps occur in a video and localize when they are performed. Existing methods are either offline, requiring access to the full video before making predictions, or online, but relying on fixed-length video segments producing noisy, over-segmented outputs. In this work, we propose Hierarchical Step Decomposition (HSD), a training-free framework for online VSG that leverages the semantic understanding capabilities of Large Multimodal Models. HSD addresses two central challenges in online grounding: constructing semantically coherent temporal segments from a streaming video, and bridging the semantic gap between coarse procedural step descriptions and visual observations. To construct elementary temporal units, HSD incrementally groups incoming segments into semantically consistent events, using an anchor caption that is continuously validated against the visual stream. Based on these events, we perform zero-shot procedural step classification and selectively refine uncertain predictions by decomposing candidate steps into finegrained substeps that capture more nuanced visual evidence. By operating on semantically coherent events rather than every fixed-length segment, HSD reduces redundant computation and produces more stable predictions. Experiments on HT-Step, Ego4D Goal-Step, and CrossTask show that HSD substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods, overall achieving better step recognition, more accurate temporal localization, and faster inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HSD，一种无需训练的在线视频步骤定位框架，通过分层步骤分解提升步骤识别、时间定位和推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有视频步骤定位方法要么需要离线访问完整视频，要么在线处理时依赖固定长度片段，导致噪声大、过分割，难以从流式视频中构建语义连贯的时间单元，也难以弥合粗粒度步骤描述与视觉观察之间的语义差距。
AI.method: HSD利用大型多模态模型的语义理解能力，首先将流入的视频片段增量聚合为语义一致的事件，并通过持续与视觉流校验的锚定描述维持事件连贯性；随后在这些事件上执行零样本程序步骤分类，并对不确定预测进行选择性细化，将候选步骤分解为更细粒度的子步骤以捕捉更细致的视觉证据。
AI.result: 在HT-Step、Ego4D Goal-Step和CrossTask上的实验表明，HSD显著优于现有方法，在步骤识别、时间定位准确性和推理速度方面均表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 通过基于语义连贯事件而非固定长度片段进行操作，HSD减少了冗余计算并提升了预测稳定性，为在线视频步骤定位提供了一种高效、训练自由且可泛化的解决框架。

title: EventSeeColor: Learning to Reconstruct Color from Monochrome Events
summary: Event cameras capture visual brightness changes under challenging lighting conditions. However, traditional event-based image reconstruction targets grayscale intensity and produces images without scene color. Color distinguishes surfaces with similar intensity. Reconstructing color from events can reveal appearance differences that reconstructed grayscale images cannot express. Although monochrome event cameras do not directly measure color, their event-triggering patterns depend on surface reflectance, illumination, and the sensor's spectral response. These patterns may contain cues that support color reconstruction. In this paper, we present EventSeeColor, which uses event-reconstructed grayscale and aligned events to jointly guide a diffusion colorizer. Grayscale-derived semantic context supports color inference, while region-balanced chroma supervision and local RGB refinement improve color distribution, brightness, and texture. In the combined evaluation on two real event datasets, EventSeeColor achieves the best structural similarity, learned perceptual scores, and chromatic-region color difference among the external methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 EventSeeColor，一种面向事件相机的彩色图像重建/上色方法：利用事件重建得到的灰度图像与对齐的事件流共同引导扩散上色器，从单色事件相机数据中恢复场景颜色。
AI.motivation: 传统基于事件的图像重建主要面向灰度强度，无法表达场景色彩。颜色可以区分灰度强度相近但外观不同的表面。虽然单色事件相机不能直接测量颜色，但其事件触发模式受到表面反射率、光照和传感器光谱响应的影响，可能包含可用于颜色重建的线索。
AI.method: 提出 EventSeeColor。该方法以事件重建得到的灰度图和与之对齐的事件作为联合引导条件，驱动扩散色彩化模型。其中，灰度图提供语义上下文以支持颜色推断；同时采用区域平衡的 chroma 监督以及局部 RGB 精修，以改善颜色分布、亮度表现和纹理细节。
AI.result: 在两个真实事件数据集上的综合评估中，该方法相较于外部基线取得了最优的结构相似度、学习感知质量分数以及彩色区域色差表现。
AI.conclusion: 单色事件相机虽然不直接获取颜色，但事件触发模式中蕴含可被利用的颜色相关线索。通过灰度重建、事件流与扩散上色联合建模，并结合色彩监督与局部精修，可以在事件数据上实现更高质量的彩色图像重建。

title: Beyond CCT: Multi-channel SPD recovery for per-shot camera color correction
summary: Modern cameras correct color via two or three pre-calibrated 3x3 matrices interpolated by Correlated Color Temperature (CCT). This collapses the illuminant SPD to a scalar. LEDs, fluorescents, and mixed sources sit off the Planckian locus, and metameric illuminants with the same chromaticity demand different optimal CCMs that a CCT pipeline cannot distinguish. We recover the illuminant SPD instead using non-negative least squares against a basis dictionary, conditioned on the camera white point and a multi-channel ambient-light sensor (ALS). A closed-form 3x3 CCM is then fit per shot. On a synthetic benchmark of 300 illuminants and 3,100 reflectances, mean angular error drops from 1.89 to 1.20 degrees, with a 1.7x tail reduction on the LED-like off-Planckian group (n=45) where metameric ambiguity is tangible. The gain holds under realistic ALS imperfections and observation noise, and the same off-Planckian advantage carries over to 1,684 real measured SPDs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出利用多通道环境光传感器与相机白点恢复照明光谱功率分布（SPD），再逐场景拟合3×3颜色校正矩阵（CCM），从而克服传统CCT方法在LED、荧光灯等非普朗克轨迹光源及同色异谱照明下的色偏校正不足。
AI.motivation: 现代相机通常通过两到三个预标定3×3矩阵进行色彩校正，并依据相关色温（CCT）插值选择矩阵。该做法本质上把照明光谱功率分布（SPD）压缩成一个标量CCT。对于LED、荧光灯以及混合光源，它们往往偏离普朗克轨迹；即使不同光源具有相同色度（即同色异谱），其最优CCM也可能不同，因此仅依赖CCT的管线难以区分这些照明，导致色彩校正误差尤其明显。
AI.method: 论文不再仅估计CCT，而是借助多通道环境光传感器（ALS）和相机白点信息，在预定义基字典上通过非负最小二乘（NNLS）重建/恢复照明SPD。随后基于恢复的SPD为每个拍摄场景拟合闭式3×3 CCM，使颜色校正能够反映真实光谱照明特性，而非仅依赖色度或CCT。
AI.result: 在包含300个照明光源和3100个反射光谱的 synthetic benchmark 中，该方法将平均角度误差从1.89°降至1.20°；在n=45的LED类非普朗克光源组上，尾部误差降低约1.7倍。该方法在真实ALS存在不完美的传感器误差和观测噪声时仍能保持增益，并且同样的非普朗克优势在1684个真实测量SPD上也成立。
AI.conclusion: 该研究说明：将颜色校正问题从CCT/色度层面的矩阵插值扩展到照明SPD恢复，并融合相机白点与多通道ALS，是一种有效改进。其核心贡献在于对同色异谱和非普朗克照明提供更精细的CCM选择，在仿真与真实测量数据上均显著降低色彩校正误差，尤其适用于LED和混合光源场景。

title: AdMuse: Skill-Guided Creative Advertising Image Generation
summary: An outstanding creative advertising image should both attract attention and communicate a product's positioning. How to choose a persuasive conceptual bridge before rendering begins is challenging for advertising generation. We present AdMuse, a skill-guided multi-agent framework that distills high-quality advertisements into reusable creative skills for cross-domain advertising strategy. Rather than retrieving isolated exemplars, AdMuse abstracts recurring bridge patterns into a skill library that can guide new product briefs. At generation time, AdMuse coordinates skill routing, multi-candidate ideation and selection, and VLM-guided visual refinement: diverse skills propose alternative concepts, relative judgment selects the most promising direction, and vision-language feedback helps realize the selected intent in the final image. This design treats advertising creativity as a structured decision process rather than a single prompt-writing step. Experiments across diverse product and brand positionings show that AdMuse produces visually compelling advertisements that faithfully communicate product positioning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AdMuse，一种技能引导的多智能体框架，将高质量广告创意抽象为可复用的“创意技能库”，并通过技能路由、多候选创意生成与选择、视觉语言模型反馈精修，提升广告图像生成对注意力和产品定位传达的效果。
AI.motivation: 优秀创意广告图像不仅需要吸引注意力，还需要准确传达产品定位。现有广告生成方法在渲染前如何选择具有说服力的“概念桥”（即连接创意表达与产品信息的中介概念）仍然困难，且直接检索孤立样例难以支撑跨领域、可迁移的广告策略。
AI.method: AdMuse采用多智能体协作流程。首先，从高质量广告中蒸馏可复用的创意技能，将反复出现的概念桥模式抽象为技能库，用于指导新的产品简报。生成时，框架依次进行：技能路由以匹配产品与创意策略；多候选构思与选择以生成并比较不同广告概念；VLM引导的视觉精修，通过视觉—语言反馈实现所选创意意图。整体将广告创意视为结构化决策过程，而非单一提示词写作步骤。
AI.result: 在多种产品和品牌定位场景下的实验表明，AdMuse能够生成视觉上具有吸引力的广告图像，并较忠实地传达产品定位。
AI.conclusion: AdMuse通过把创意模式沉淀为可复用技能库，并用多智能体协作完成策略选择与视觉实现，为广告创意生成提供了结构化、跨领域可迁移的解决方案，有助于兼顾视觉吸引力与品牌定位传达。

title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Video generation is shifting from end-to-end synthesis toward agentic generation, where planning, tool use, and feedback enable coherent, controllable multi-shot videos. In parallel, video world models provide action-conditioned observations and predicted futures, serving as interactive environments for agents. We study their intersection through the agent harness: an executable runtime that constructs context, exposes tools, maintains state, routes feedback, and manages budgets around video models. This report examines three directions. First, agentic video generation, where harnesses coordinate scripting, shot planning, asset management, production, and editing, alongside the evaluation challenges of these systems. Second, agentic world modeling, where harnesses mediate observation, control, execution, and state. We discuss hybrid designs in which game engines or agent-written programs maintain world state while video models render observations, and how agents and world models can mutually evaluate and improve one another. Third, recursive self-improvement (RSI) in video model development, distinguishing output revisions, updates to harness state, generator parameters, and evaluators, and changes to the improvement procedure itself. We identify how these improvements feed back into subsequent development. Across these directions, we analyze essential agent capabilities, including audiovisual perception, long-horizon planning, memory, code-based interaction, feedback-guided control, skill reuse, and multi-agent coordination. We conclude with challenges in autonomous video production, lifelong memory, programmable hybrid control, autonomous model development, provenance, cost accounting, and evaluation linking video quality and task performance to sustained improvements in models and harnesses.
