AI.tldr: 该摘要提出以“agent harness”（智能体执行运行时）为核心视角，系统分析视频生成从端到端合成转向智能体化生成，并与视频世界模型交汇的三条研究路线。
AI.motivation: 随着视频模型能力增强，单靠端到端生成难以满足多镜头、可控、连贯和交互式视频生产需求；同时，视频世界模型可作为智能体的交互环境。作者旨在明确二者结合所需的运行时机制、关键智能体能力以及长期改进闭环。
AI.method: 这是一篇概念性/综述性报告。作者将 agent harness 定义为围绕视频模型构建上下文、暴露工具、维护状态、路由反馈和管理预算的可执行运行时，并据此梳理三个方向：智能体化视频生成、智能体化世界建模、以及视频模型开发中的递归自我改进（RSI）。
AI.result: 摘要归纳出智能体化视频生产的流程与评估难题，提出世界建模中的混合设计——由游戏引擎或智能体编写的程序维护世界状态、由视频模型渲染观测，并讨论智能体与世界模型互相评估和改进；同时区分 RSI 的不同层级：修改输出、更新 harness 状态、修改生成器参数与评估器、以及改变改进流程本身。
AI.conclusion: 视频智能体与视频世界模型的进一步融合，需要长期记忆、视听感知、长程规划、代码交互、反馈控制、技能复用和多智能体协同等能力；仍面临自主视频生产、可编程混合控制、自主模型开发、数据/生成来源追溯、成本核算，以及将视频质量与任务表现稳定转化为模型和 harness 持续改进的评估挑战。

title: Benchmarking color judgment in multimodal LLMs with CIE-computable ground truth
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are now used as zero-shot judges of image quality, but their color judgments are rarely tested with colorimetric ground truth. We present a five-task benchmark based on the CIE colorimetric framework: AWB pair judgment, skin-tone bias direction, CCT estimation, CIE Delta E 2000 pair ordering, and color naming under changing illuminants. We test eight MLLM endpoints, including four Qwen3-VL variants, GLM-4.5V, GPT-5.4, Claude-Opus-4.7, and Gemini-3.1-Pro. The models often solve coarse binary AWB judgments, but they remain weak on numeric CCT estimation and on some fine color-difference judgments. On ColorChecker-24 stimuli, the three closed-weight frontier models reach CCT MAE of 715-1056 K, compared with 1358-2133 K for the five open-weight models. A non-ColorChecker control shows that this advantage is partly template-dependent. The results suggest that current MLLMs have useful color words and coarse visual priors, but their color judgments are not reliably calibrated to CIE-computable color differences.

AI.tldr: 该摘要提出一个基于CIE色彩度量框架的五任务基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在图像质量零样本判断中的颜色感知能力；实验显示模型能处理粗粒度颜色判断，但在色温估计和细粒度色差排序/校准上仍不稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM常被用作图像质量零样本评审，但其颜色判断缺乏色彩科学层面的定量真值验证。作者希望检验模型是否真正具备与CIE色彩度量体系相一致的颜色感知、估计和排序能力，而非仅依赖粗略视觉先验或语言先验。
AI.method: 作者构建五个任务：自动白平衡成对判断、肤色偏差方向判断、相关色温估计、基于CIE Delta E 2000的成对色差排序，以及不同光照条件下的颜色命名。实验测试八个模型端点，包括四个Qwen3-VL变体、GLM-4.5V、GPT-5.4、Claude-Opus-4.7和Gemini-3.1-Pro，并在ColorChecker-24刺激与非ColorChecker控制刺激上比较闭源与开源模型的表现。
AI.result: MLLM在较粗粒度的二元AWB判断上通常表现尚可，但在数值化色温估计和部分精细色差判断上仍然较弱。在ColorChecker-24条件下，三个闭源前沿模型的CCT平均绝对误差为715–1056 K，而五个开源模型为1358–2133 K；但在非ColorChecker控制实验中，这种优势部分依赖于测试模板或材料类型。
AI.conclusion: 当前MLLM已具备一定颜色词知识和粗略视觉先验，可用于简单颜色判别，但其颜色判断尚未可靠地校准到CIE可计算的色差与色温标准。对于高质量图像评审、色彩一致性检测和摄影后期等任务，不能直接假定MLLM具有稳定的量化色彩判断能力。

title: TaskFrame: Connecting Task-Level Planning with Frame-Level Control for Game Agents
summary: Building general game agents requires both high-level task reasoning and low-latency action control in rapidly changing visual environments. These capabilities favor models with substantially different computational profiles, making them difficult to realize within a single model. In this work, we present TaskFrame, a hierarchical planner-controller framework that connects task-level planning with frame-level keyboard-and-mouse control. A vision-language task planner decomposes a high-level goal into an ordered sequence of atomic instructions and is optimized through supervised learning and dependency-aware GRPO. The hidden states of special goal tokens that terminate each atomic instruction provide continuous goal embeddings that are cached and reused across control steps. A causal Transformer controller combines the embedding of the active goal with recent observations to predict discrete keyboard and mouse-button actions and continuous camera motion at every game step. We train the system in three stages: planner training, controller pretraining, and joint alignment. Experiments in Minecraft show that TaskFrame is competitive with general-purpose vision-language models on instruction decomposition, and that in closed-loop evaluation the agent achieves a higher combat success rate than the evaluated baselines.

AI.tldr: TaskFrame提出“任务级规划—帧级控制”的层级智能体框架，在Minecraft中将高层任务分解与低延迟键鼠动作控制连接起来。
AI.motivation: 通用游戏智能体既需要高层任务推理，又需要在快速变化的视觉环境中进行低延迟动作控制；这两类能力计算需求差异较大，难以由单一模型同时高效完成。
AI.method: 框架包含视觉语言任务规划器与因果Transformer控制器。规划器将高层目标分解为有序原子指令，并通过监督学习和考虑依赖关系的GRPO优化；每条指令末尾的特殊目标token隐藏状态被用作连续目标嵌入，并在控制步之间缓存复用。控制器将当前目标嵌入与近期观测结合，逐帧预测离散键盘/鼠标按键动作和连续相机运动。训练分三阶段：规划器训练、控制器预训练和联合对齐。
AI.result: 在Minecraft实验中，TaskFrame在指令分解任务上与通用视觉语言模型相比具有竞争力；在闭环评估中，相比所评测基线取得了更高的战斗成功率。
AI.conclusion: TaskFrame验证了层级规划—控制结构对游戏智能体的有效性：通过目标嵌入将高层任务推理稳定传递给低层动作控制，可兼顾任务分解能力与实时交互控制能力。

title: Textual Response-Aware Guidance for Zero-Shot Adversarial Robustness of Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot generalization but remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Existing adversarial fine-tuning methods often use pre-trained model guidance to preserve image--text alignment while improving robustness. Our analysis of visual representation drift reveals complementary limitations of two representative forms of guidance. Matching visual features provides broad coverage by constraining all directions equally, but lacks semantic emphasis. Matching prediction distributions prioritizes semantically relevant directions, but remains limited by the candidate texts and prediction probabilities. These limitations can hinder preservation of pre-trained image--text relationships and degrade zero-shot performance. To address these issues, we propose Textual Response-Aware Guidance (TRAG), which constrains visual representation drift using the pre-trained text encoder's responses to local variations in input embeddings. Specifically, TRAG constructs anchor-level constraints from the response directions and magnitudes around semantic anchors, then aggregates them using pre-trained image--anchor relevance, yielding an image-adaptive constraint. Extensive experiments across architectures and tasks demonstrate state-of-the-art clean and robust performance. Further analysis shows that TRAG helps preserve pre-trained image--text relationships.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对视觉-语言模型在对抗微调中易发生视觉表征漂移、损害图文对齐与零样本性能的问题，提出文本响应感知引导（TRAG），通过预训练文本编码器对输入嵌入局部变化的响应构建图像自适应约束，从而在提升鲁棒性的同时更好保持预训练图文关系，并取得优异的干净与对抗性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型对抗微调方法通常借助预训练模型引导来维持图文对齐并提升鲁棒性。作者发现视觉表征漂移揭示了两类代表性引导方式的互补缺陷：匹配视觉特征能在所有方向上提供较宽泛约束，但缺乏语义侧重；匹配预测分布能强调语义相关方向，但受限于候选文本集合与预测概率。这些不足可能削弱预训练图像-文本关系的保持，并导致零样本性能下降。
AI.method: 提出文本响应感知引导（TRAG）。该方法不是直接约束视觉特征或预测分布，而是利用预训练文本编码器对局部输入嵌入变化的响应来约束视觉表征漂移。具体地，TRAG在语义锚点附近根据响应方向和响应幅度构造锚点级约束，再依据预训练图像与锚点的相关性对这些约束进行聚合，形成面向当前图像的自适应约束，从而在对抗微调中保留图像-文本对齐结构。
AI.result: 在多种模型架构和任务上进行大量实验，结果显示 TRAG 在干净样本性能和对抗鲁棒性能上均达到领先水平。进一步分析表明，TRAG 有助于保持预训练模型原有的图像-文本关系。
AI.conclusion: TRAG 通过文本编码器的局部响应建模视觉表征漂移，有效弥补了现有视觉特征匹配与预测分布匹配两类引导机制的不足，为视觉-语言模型对抗微调提供了更语义敏感、图像自适应的对齐保持机制，可同时改善鲁棒性与零样本泛化能力。

title: RFW-A: Agentic Procedural Generation of 400K Articulated Assets over 500 Categories
summary: High-quality articulated assets are essential for embodied perception, simulation, and manipulation, yet constructing them at scale remains difficult. Manual annotation and procedural modeling require substantial human effort. Recent agentic systems automate asset construction through program synthesis, but repeat costly reasoning and refinement for every new asset. Our key observation is that assets within a category can share construction logic despite variations in structure and appearance. Agentic synthesis and procedural generation are therefore complementary: agents can construct reusable programs, while procedural execution reuses the resulting logic across many samples. We therefore present RFW-A, which combines the two in a new articulated-asset generation paradigm. Starting from existing articulated programs, RFW-A organizes reusable components and their dependencies into category-level generators. Agents test and refine these generators across sampled configurations and motion states. Once constructed and validated, the generators produce diverse assets through procedural execution with no further model calls or token charges. The estimated API cost of generator authoring averages $10.62, amortizing to $0.05 per asset over 200 assets, versus $1.24 for the sampled per-asset agentic synthesis baseline. Using RFW-A, we built RFW-A-400K, containing over 400K sim-ready articulated assets across more than 500 categories. Experiments show high structural and kinematic validity and stable execution across physics simulators. Beyond asset validity, training with RFW-A-400K improves part-level articulation estimation on seen and unseen categories, while policies trained in simulation with retrieved and program-edited assets transfer zero-shot to real articulated objects.

title: Wizard: Manipulate Any World in Real Time via Agentic Control
summary: Recent advances in video world models have enabled the generation of increasingly realistic and interactive virtual environments, opening new possibilities for player-customizable gameplay. Agentic frameworks further advance this direction by decoupling explicit game logic and controllable world representations from visual generation. However, existing approaches support only simple game settings and predefined motion patterns, generalize poorly to unseen environments and characters, and offer limited real-time interactivity. In this paper, we introduce Wizard, an agentic game world model that enables real-time, precise control over character motions while generalizing zero-shot across novel scenes, characters, and actions. To achieve this, we construct a diverse dataset spanning 750 scenes and 178 characters, incorporating skeleton and geometry information as structured representations. We leverage these representations as intermediate proxies to condition a video generation model, together with an adaptive masking mechanism that improves alignment between the conditioning signals and generated video rollouts. Furthermore, we introduce an agentic framework that explicitly maintains and updates game states, allowing players to freely configure their virtual worlds and exercise fine-grained control over character motions while preserving visual quality and gameplay consistency. By combining agentic control with structured proxy-based generation, our framework unlocks new possibilities for player-driven game creation with real-time, generalizable, and mechanically consistent world simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Wizard：一种面向可定制游戏的智能体式世界模型，能够通过结构化中间表示（骨架、几何）和自适应掩码机制，在实时生成视频的同时实现对角色动作的精确控制，并在新场景、新角色、新动作上实现零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型和智能体游戏框架虽可生成交互式虚拟环境，但通常仅支持简单游戏设定与预设动作模式，难以泛化到未见场景与角色，且实时交互能力有限；因此需要一种既能保持高质量视频生成、又能实现显式游戏逻辑、可控世界表示和细粒度角色动作控制的框架。
AI.method: 作者构建了覆盖750个场景、178个角色的多样化数据集，并引入骨架与几何信息作为结构化表示。这些表示被用作中间代理，用于条件化视频生成模型；同时设计自适应掩码机制，提升条件信号与生成视频序列之间的对齐。另一方面，提出智能体式框架，显式维护并更新游戏状态，使玩家能够自由配置虚拟世界，并在不牺牲视觉质量和游戏一致性的前提下对角色动作进行精细控制。
AI.result: 通过结合智能体式控制与基于结构化代理的视频生成，Wizard 实现了实时、精确且可泛化的角色动作控制，并支持对新场景、新角色和新动作的零样本泛化，同时保持视觉质量与玩法一致性。
AI.conclusion: Wizard 展示了将显式游戏状态建模、结构化世界表示与视频生成模型相结合的有效性，为玩家驱动的实时游戏创造、开放世界模拟和可交互虚拟环境提供了新方向。

title: HiFOR: Hierarchical Foresight with Action-Guided World Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated promising capabilities in robotic manipulation by integrating visual perception, language understanding, and action generation. Recent advances have further incorporated future prediction to enhance the understanding of environmental dynamics and task progression. However, existing methods often model short-term dynamics and long-term task objectives separately, while directly incorporating predicted futures into action policies without sufficiently considering their relevance to current action requirements. To address these limitations, we propose HiFOR, a hierarchical foresight framework with action-guided world retrieval. Specifically, Hierarchical Foresight Prediction jointly predicts short-term state evolution, semantic milestones, and final goal states through a Hierarchical Dependency Mask (HDM), establishing dependencies across temporal horizons. Building upon these predictions, Structure-Aware Latent World Modeling organizes future latent representations along the horizon, view, and spatial dimensions to facilitate fine-grained retrieval. Furthermore, Action-Guided Factorized World Retrieval adaptively retrieves relevant future information from the structured latent world based on evolving action representations during denoising, providing targeted guidance for action generation. Extensive experiments on two simulation benchmarks and six real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HiFOR，一种面向机器人操作的层级前瞻预测框架，通过分层预测短期状态、语义里程碑和最终目标，并在动作去噪过程中进行结构感知的潜在世界检索，以增强当前动作生成。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型虽引入未来预测以提升对环境动态和任务进程的理解，但通常将短期动态与长期任务目标分开建模，且直接将预测未来并入动作策略时，缺少对当前动作相关性的充分考量，导致预测信息与动作生成之间对齐不足。
AI.method: 方法包括三个核心部分：（1）Hierarchical Foresight Prediction：通过Hierarchical Dependency Mask联合预测短期状态演化、语义里程碑和最终目标状态，建立不同时间尺度之间的依赖关系；（2）Structure-Aware Latent World Modeling：沿horizon、view和space组织未来潜在表征，以支持细粒度检索；（3）Action-Guided Factorized World Retrieval：在扩散式动作去噪过程中，根据不断演化的动作表征自适应地检索相关的未来潜在信息，为动作生成提供定向引导。
AI.result: 在两个仿真基准和六个真实世界机器人操作任务上进行了充分实验，结果表明该方法相较于现有VLA与未来预测方法具有更好的有效性。
AI.conclusion: HiFOR通过将层级前瞻预测与动作引导的结构化世界检索相结合，有效连接短期动态、中期语义里程碑和长期目标，使未来预测更紧密地服务于当前动作生成，从而提升机器人操作中的决策与控制能力。

title: PhysInsert: Physically Plausible Object Insertion with Geometric Priors and Bidirectional Object-Scene Interactions
summary: We present PhysInsert, a framework for physically plausible reference-based object insertion that jointly adapts objects and their surrounding scenes. Existing methods often rely on masked inputs, generation-based pairs, or training pairs with limited viewpoint variation, leaving pose and illumination adaptation and bidirectional object-scene interactions insufficiently constrained. We construct the Insert World dataset with strictly aligned Blender-rendered counterfactual pairs and object references across viewpoints and lighting conditions. Building on these data, Geometry-Guided Adaptation couples a VGGT geometry stream with image and text streams under target-scene feature supervision to guide spatially consistent insertion. Complementary 2D Object-Scene Spatial Supervision jointly supervises object occupancy and environmental changes while grounding spatial instructions in object regions through image-text attention. We introduce PhysInsert-Bench with dedicated cross-environment and cross-view cases requiring illumination and pose adaptation beyond appearance copying. Experiments on PhysInsert-Bench and DreamBooth demonstrate improved image fidelity; a user study further shows more accurate placement and improved lighting integration, perspective, and pose plausibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PhysInsert，一种面向物理合理性的参考图物体插入框架，通过联合适配目标物体与周围场景，实现跨视角、跨光照下的空间一致插入。

AI.conclusion: PhysInsert 通过对齐的渲染数据、几何引导适配和双向物体-场景空间监督，有效增强了参考图物体插入中的光照与姿态适应能力，使插入结果更具物理合理性和环境一致性。

title: AVPS-360: A Spatial Audio-Visual Benchmark for Instance Segmentation and Tracking of Sound-Producing Persons
summary: Audio-visual instance segmentation (AVIS) segments and tracks individual sound-producing objects in videos. Existing benchmarks predominantly use monaural audio, which lacks inter-channel cues for spatially distinguishing concurrent sound sources. We introduce AVPS-360 (Audio-Visual Person Segmentation 360), a spatial audio-visual benchmark bridging AVIS and sound event localisation and detection (SELD). Built upon STARSS23, it pairs first-order Ambisonics audio with synchronised 360° video across 230 recordings totalling 10.5 hours. Recordings average 164.0 seconds. The dataset captures intermittent sound production in real-world interactions dominated by speech, alongside laughter, clapping, and footsteps. It provides 31,678 manually reviewed instance masks linked to source identities and sound-event labels. We also present a baseline that integrates spatial audio with visual features for frame-level segmentation and identity association across frames. Experiments on AVPS-360 show that existing AVIS methods struggle with detection and identity association in long recordings with intermittent sound production, while our baseline substantially improves performance in both aspects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AVPS-360 空间音视频人物分割基准，并给出融合一阶 Ambisonics 空间音频与 360° 视觉特征的基线方法，以提升长视频、间歇性发声场景中的实例分割、检测与身份关联性能。
AI.motivation: 现有音频视觉实例分割基准多使用单声道音频，缺少声道间线索，难以在并发声源之间进行空间区分；同时真实长视频中的发声行为具有间歇性，给目标检测、分割和跨帧身份关联带来挑战。
AI.method: 基于 STARSS23 构建 AVPS-360 数据集，将一阶 Ambisonics 空间音频与同步 360° 视频配对，覆盖 230 条、共 10.5 小时、平均 164.0 秒的录音，包含以语音为主并伴有笑声、鼓掌、脚步声等的间歇性发声场景。数据集中提供 31,678 个经人工审核的实例掩码，并关联声源身份与声音事件标签。作者进一步提出基线方法，联合空间音频与视觉特征，实现帧级分割和跨帧身份关联。
AI.result: 在 AVPS-360 上的实验表明，已有 AVIS 方法在长录制、间歇性发声场景中的检测和身份关联表现不足；所提出的融合空间音频与视觉信息的基线在这两方面均显著改善性能。
AI.conclusion: AVPS-360 将音频视觉实例分割与声音事件定位检测连接起来，提供了更具空间性和真实性的评测基准；结果表明空间音频线索对于并发声源区分、长视频分割和身份关联至关重要。

title: MetaRefine: Score Refinement with Multi-Level Features for Image Assessment
summary: An image's original dimensions, aspect ratio, and composition provide important cues that can affect its technical and aesthetic quality. Image assessment methods use resizing, cropping, padding, or patch sampling to accommodate different input sizes. However, these operations can alter or obscure original geometric and compositional cues. Existing assessment models also encode rich multi-level visual evidence that can be further extracted and exploited to improve existing models. This motivates us to combine visual evidence with original-image geometry for score refinement without changing the original scoring pipelines. In this paper, we introduce MetaRefine, a metadata-aware score refinement architecture whose lightweight residual heads predict score corrections from geometry, multi-level visual features, and the frozen model's original score. Across 100 configurations on 21 datasets, MetaRefine improves PLCC in 88 configurations and SRCC in 85, with average relative gains of 7.55% and 7.10%, respectively. It reduces MAE in 90 configurations and RMSE in 89, with average relative reductions of 23.27% and 21.93%, respectively. The median parameter overhead is only 1.11%. MetaRefine can further improve state-of-the-art (SOTA) assessment models on multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MetaRefine，一种元数据感知的图像质量/美学评分精化架构，通过轻量残差头结合原图尺寸、宽高比、构图等几何线索与多层视觉特征及冻结模型的原始评分，对评分进行修正，在不改变原有评分流程的前提下显著提升相关性并降低误差。
AI.motivation: 现有图像质量或美学评估方法常通过缩放、裁剪、填充或patch采样适配固定输入尺寸，这可能破坏或掩盖原图的尺寸、宽高比和构图等几何与构图线索。同时，模型内部编码的多层视觉证据仍有进一步利用的空间。因此，需要一种能够融合原图几何元数据与视觉证据、并以低成本精化冻结模型评分的方法。
AI.method: 提出MetaRefine，采用轻量残差头作为评分精化模块。该模块利用三类信息进行修正预测：1）原图几何/元数据，包括尺寸、宽高比和构图相关线索；2）多层视觉特征；3）冻结评估模型输出的原始分数。MetaRefine以插件式方式工作，不修改原有评分pipeline，只额外学习残差修正项。
AI.result: 在21个数据集、100组配置上进行验证。MetaRefine在88个配置中提升PLCC，在85个配置中提升SRCC，平均相对提升分别为7.55%和7.10%；在90个配置中降低MAE，在89个配置中降低RMSE，平均相对下降分别为23.27%和21.93%。中位参数量开销仅1.11%，并可在多个基准上进一步提升SOTA评估模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 将原图几何/元数据信息与多层视觉证据结合，可有效精化冻结模型评分，且几乎不增加计算和参数负担。MetaRefine展示了不改动主干模型而实现跨数据集、跨配置一致性提升的可能性，为图像质量与美学评估提供了低成本插件式增强方案。

title: LucidLyra: Feed-Forward Generative 3D Scene Reconstruction and Joint Understanding via Multi-Task Distillation
summary: We present LucidLyra, a framework that makes generatively reconstructed 3D scenes directly queryable for semantics and instances in a feed-forward manner from video latents. While generative 3D reconstruction can synthesize virtual environments from a single image, downstream applications in robotics and physical AI require not only visual realism but also access to scene semantics and object identities. Existing 3D understanding approaches, however, require captured multi-view scenes, have limited generalization capabilities, or rely on expensive per-scene processing and optimization. To bridge this gap, our method distills complementary knowledge from a camera-controlled video diffusion model and frozen 2D vision foundation models into a unified model to jointly infer 3D Gaussians encoding geometry, appearance, open-vocabulary semantics, and class-agnostic instance cues. The resulting scenes support novel-view rendering, open-vocabulary segmentation, and object grouping without per-scene optimization, while training requires neither manual 3D annotations nor captured multi-view data. Our method outperforms baselines combining state-of-the-art 3DGS segmentation approaches with generative 3D scene reconstruction on curated synthetic and real-image-conditioned benchmarks, while preserving reconstruction quality. Furthermore, our latent formulation naturally extends to monocular video, reconstructing structured dynamic 3D scenes across time. By turning renderable but unstructured outputs into queryable 3D worlds, LucidLyra enables downstream applications including 3D scene editing, 3D asset mining, and robotic simulation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LucidLyra：一种前馈式生成式 3D 重建框架，能够从视频潜变量直接生成可语义查询、可实例查询的 3D 高斯场景，支持新视角渲染、开放词表分割和对象分组，无需逐场景优化或 3D 标注。
AI.motivation: 生成式 3D 重建可以从单张图像生成虚拟环境，但机器人和物理 AI 等下游应用不仅需要视觉真实感，还需要场景语义和对象身份信息。现有 3D 场景理解方法通常依赖真实采集的多视角数据、泛化能力有限，或需要昂贵的逐场景处理与优化，难以直接服务于生成式 3D 场景。
AI.method: LucidLyra 将相机控制的视频扩散模型与冻结的 2D 视觉基础模型中的互补知识蒸馏到一个统一模型中，联合推断编码几何、外观、开放词表语义和类别无关实例线索的 3D 高斯。该方法以前馈方式从视频潜变量生成结构化 3D 场景，无需手动 3D 标注或采集多视角数据，并自然扩展到单目视频，从而重建跨时间的动态 3D 场景。
AI.result: 在合成图像和真实图像条件基准上，LucidLyra 优于将当前先进 3D 高斯分割方法与生成式 3D 场景重建相结合基线，同时保持重建质量。生成的场景支持新视角渲染、开放词表分割和对象分组，且不依赖逐场景优化。
AI.conclusion: LucidLyra 将可渲染但非结构化的生成式 3D 输出转化为可直接查询的 3D 世界，为 3D 场景编辑、3D 资产挖掘和机器人仿真等下游应用提供了更高效、可泛化的场景理解接口。

title: CrossWeave: Cross-Modal Scene and Instance Retrieval from Sparse 2D-3D Alignment
summary: Cross-modal scene and instance retrieval aims to retrieve a corresponding 3D environment or object given query 2D images, serving as a foundational mechanism for spatial reasoning in robotics and AR/VR. Existing methods achieve this by learning alignment only at the level of whole scenes or objects, which provides no supervision for the fine-grained local structure within them. In this work, we show that supervision on a set of sparse 2D-3D correspondences, without scene- or instance-level contrastive objectives, is sufficient to train a single model for both scene- and instance-level retrieval. Specifically, we propose $\textbf{CrossWeave}$, a novel framework for cross-modal retrieval that learns sparse patch-point alignment, which alone outperforms existing methods. An optimal transport-based aggregator over the aligned features gives further gains by clustering structurally redundant regions, freeing descriptor capacity for semantically distinct local features. CrossWeave achieves state-of-the-art performance on both scene- and instance-level retrieval on ScanNet and 3RScan with a $\textit{single model}$, whereas existing methods require separate models for each task. Our results suggest that whole-scene encoding is unnecessary for cross-modal retrieval and that sparse local correspondence supervision is a more effective and flexible alternative.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrossWeave，一种仅依赖稀疏2D-3D局部对应监督、无需场景级或实例级对比目标即可同时实现跨模态场景检索与实例检索的统一框架，并在ScanNet和3RScan上达到单模型SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态3D场景与实例检索方法通常在完整场景或完整对象层面进行对齐，缺乏对细粒度局部结构的监督；这限制了模型对局部语义和结构关系的表达能力，也往往需要针对不同检索层级训练不同模型。
AI.method: 提出CrossWeave框架，核心是稀疏patch-point对齐：通过稀疏2D图像patch与3D点之间的对应关系提供局部监督，而不使用场景级或实例级对比损失。进一步采用基于最优传输的聚合器对已对齐特征进行聚类，减少结构冗余区域的特征占用，将描述子容量释放给语义上更具区分性的局部特征。
AI.result: 在ScanNet和3RScan数据集上，CrossWeave使用单一模型同时取得场景级与实例级跨模态检索的state-of-the-art性能，优于需要分别训练模型或仅进行粗粒度对齐的现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，跨模态检索不必依赖整体场景编码；稀疏局部对应监督是一种更有效、更灵活且可统一多任务检索目标的替代范式。

title: PhysCount: Do MLLMs Count Visual Appearances or Physical Entities?
summary: Images reveal appearances, but counting often asks about physical objects. A single entity may be visible directly, in several reflections, or through glass, so detecting every visible occurrence does not determine how many entities are present. Existing visual counting benchmarks rarely separate these two operations. We introduce PhysCount, a benchmark for evaluating whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can distinguish what appears in an image from what physically exists in the scene. PhysCount contains 546 real-world images and 4,595 human-written questions organized into 651 target-specific groups. For each group, annotators locate the relevant appearances, label how each is observed, and identify appearances of the same entity. Four complementary question families test the enumeration of appearances, the enumeration of physical entities, image-formation-specific counting, and appearance--entity correspondence. We measure both accuracy on each family and the proportion of groups answered entirely correctly. Across 40 MLLMs, counting visible appearances is substantially easier than recovering the identities that connect them. Even the strongest model answers every question correctly in only 13.36\% of groups. Performance declines when one entity produces many appearances or when its appearances cross observation modes. Higher image resolution improves access to visual evidence but brings limited gains in complete-group accuracy, whereas answering related questions jointly produces a marked improvement. These results expose a gap between recognizing what is visible and correctly recovering the physical entities behind those observations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhysCount基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型区分“图像中可见外观”与“真实物理实体”的能力，发现当前模型在实体身份恢复与跨观测模式计数上仍存在显著不足。
AI.motivation: 视觉计数通常关注“图像里看到多少个对象”，但真实问题往往要求统计物理世界中实际存在的实体数量。同一实体可能以直接可见、镜面反射、玻璃透视等多种外观出现，单纯检测所有可见区域无法确定真实实体数量。现有视觉计数基准很少显式区分“外观枚举”与“物理实体枚举”，导致难以评估模型是否真正理解图像形成机制与实体同一性。
AI.method: 作者构建PhysCount数据集，包含546张真实场景图像、4595个人工编写问题，并组织成651个目标特定问题组。每个问题组中，标注者定位相关外观、标注观测方式，并判断哪些外观属于同一物理实体。基准设置四类互补问题：统计可见外观数量、统计物理实体数量、图像形成机制相关计数、外观与实体对应关系。评估指标包括各问题族准确率，以及整组全部回答正确的比例。
AI.result: 对40个多模态大语言模型的测试表明，模型在计数可见外观上明显优于恢复实体身份。最强模型仅在13.36%的问题组中全部回答正确。当单个实体产生更多外观，或外观跨越不同观测模式时，性能显著下降。提高图像分辨率能增强视觉证据获取，但对整组完全正确率提升有限；联合回答相关问题则能明显提升表现。
AI.conclusion: PhysCount揭示了当前多模态模型在“识别可见内容”与“推断真实物理实体”之间存在明显差距。模型能够检测图像中的视觉片段，但难以稳定完成跨反射、透视等观测模式的实体同一性绑定。该基准为评估和改进MLLM的物理场景理解、计数与视觉推理提供了新的方向。

title: HairDeck: Animation-Ready Stylized Hair Cards from a Single Image
summary: The hair of stylized characters in games and avatars is built from hair cards: artist-placed ribbons whose geometry is the visible hair, animated by spring bones. Existing image-based methods produce realistic hair or a single fused mesh, while CHARM, the only generator of stylized hair cards, decodes a hairstyle autoregressively as a long sequence of control points. Observing that a card hairstyle is an unordered set of artist-defined primitives, we propose HairDeck, which generates it as one: each card is a single token, and a set diffusion transformer denoises all cards together. From a single image, HairDeck generates the cards and the spring-bone chains that drive them, yielding an animatable asset that exports to ready-to-use downstream formats. On CHARM's own test set, it lowers Chamfer distance by 44% and card-orientation error by more than half while running 33 times faster, and from single images it outperforms CHARM, image-to-3D pipelines and strand-based methods. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: HairDeck 将风格化发型卡片建模为无序图元集合，并用集合扩散 Transformer 生成可动画的头发卡片资产。
AI.motivation: 现有图像生成方法难以输出游戏/虚拟形象中可编辑、可动画的 hair cards；CHARM 虽能生成头发卡片，但采用自回归控制点序列，忽略了卡片作为艺术家定义图元的无序集合属性，导致效率和几何方向一致性受限。
AI.method: 提出 HairDeck：将每张头发卡片视为单个 token，将发型表示为无序卡片集合；使用集合 diffusion transformer 同时对所有卡片进行去噪生成。该方法可从单张图像生成头发卡片及其对应的 spring-bone 驱动链，从而得到可直接用于下游流程的动画资产。
AI.result: 在 CHARM 测试集上，HairDeck 将 Chamfer distance 降低 44%，卡片方向误差降低超过一半，同时推理速度提升约 33 倍；在单图输入条件下，也优于 CHARM、image-to-3D 流水线和 strand-based 方法。
AI.conclusion: HairDeck 证明了将头发卡片作为无序集合而非自回归序列建模，能显著提升风格化头发资产生成的质量、方向一致性和效率，并更适合游戏与虚拟形象中的可动画资产生产流程。

title: Fight World Model: Customizable Combat through Visual Interaction Proxies
summary: A playable, programmable game world must maintain persistent state, enforce executable rules, and support extensible gameplay mechanics. Existing video world models can generate plausible combat, yet struggle to keep hit reactions and health updates consistent with game rules. We introduce Fight World Model (FWM), which separates rule-governed combat execution from video rendering. An executable engine maintains state and resolves interactions. A deterministic compiler encodes these outcomes and attempted actions in a spatially and temporally aligned interaction proxy. The proxy aligns action and skill windows, brief hit reactions, and persistent health by fighter identity and timing. These cues can be controlled separately to render interactions under modified rules. Identity-bound references preserve character appearance across side switches. We train FWM on FightWorld Corpus, spanning 52 skill effects, 187 character-appearance variants, and 15 arenas. Without retraining the renderer, FWM supports damage scaling, limited-hit immunity, lifesteal, and multi-stage skill mechanisms beyond the native game. It also allows character and arena customization. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of FWM, which outperforms existing game world models in action fidelity, hit reactions, health-state consistency, and character appearance preservation. Our project is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: Fight World Model (FWM)将可执行游戏规则与视频渲染解耦，通过战斗引擎和时空对齐的交互代理生成更稳定、可控且可扩展的游戏战斗世界。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型虽然能生成看似合理的战斗画面，但难以保证受击反应、血量更新等与持久游戏规则一致，缺少可玩、可编程游戏世界所需的状态维护、规则执行和玩法扩展能力。
AI.method: FWM由可执行引擎负责维护战斗状态并结算交互，再通过确定性编译器将动作与结果编码为空间和时间上对齐的交互代理，其中按角色身份与时间对齐技能窗口、短暂时击反应和持续血量。这些信号可被独立控制以在不同规则下渲染交互；身份绑定参考图用于在角色换位时保持外观一致。模型在FightWorld语料库上训练，该语料覆盖52种技能效果、187个角色外观变体和15个竞技场。
AI.result: 实验表明，FWM无需重新训练渲染器即可支持伤害倍率、限次无敌、吸血和多阶段技能等超出原始游戏机制的玩法，也支持角色与竞技场定制；在动作保真度、受击反应、血量状态一致性和角色外观保持方面优于现有游戏世界模型。
AI.conclusion: 将规则执行与视频渲染解耦，并通过时空对齐的交互代理控制关键游戏状态，可显著提升可玩游戏世界中视觉生成与持久规则的一致性、可扩展性和可控性。

title: L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory
summary: Interactive world models generate visual content conditioned on user actions, yet maintaining spatial consistency over long-horizon exploration in real time remains challenging. Existing approaches rely on either temporal context or explicit 3D memory, both of which scale poorly because memory grows with the length of the generated stream. Moreover, explicit 3D memories condition latent video generators by re-encoding RGB renderings, which precludes real-time generation. In this paper, we introduce a Latent 3D Gaussian Memory (L3G) that combines the efficiency of feed-forward reconstruction with a compact, rapidly renderable scene representation. Building on this memory, we propose L3G-World, in which a memory updater and a video diffusion transformer (DiT) alternate autoregressively to generate spatially consistent worlds. The memory updater spawns Gaussians in newly observed regions and refines existing ones, so that the memory grows with scene extent rather than stream length. Each Gaussian further stores a VAE latent feature, allowing the memory to be rendered directly into the DiT's latent space without VAE re-encoding. Experiments show that L3G-World achieves state-of-the-art generation quality and long-horizon spatial consistency, with up to $38.6\times$ fewer 3D primitives, $3.2\times$ faster memory updates, and $359\times$ faster memory rendering relative to the most efficient prior 3D-memory baseline for each metric, enabling real-time world generation at 9 FPS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 L3G-World：一种交互式世界模型方法，使用“潜在三维高斯记忆”（Latent 3D Gaussian Memory, L3G）存储紧凑、可快速渲染的场景表示，使视频扩散 Transformer 能够在实时生成过程中保持长时程空间一致性。</motivation>
AI.motivation: 现有交互式世界模型依赖时序上下文或显式 3D 记忆，但二者随生成流长度增长而扩展性差；显式 3D 记忆还需将 RGB 渲染结果重新编码回潜在空间，阻碍实时生成。核心问题是：如何以与场景范围相关、而非生成时长相关的内存成本，提供可用于视频生成器的、可快速读取的空间一致性记忆？
AI.method: 提出 L3G：每个 3D Gaussian 存储 VAE latent feature，使记忆可直接渲染到视频 DiT 的潜在空间，避免重新编码 RGB。构建 L3G-World：记忆更新器与视频 DiT 自回归交替工作；记忆更新器在新观测区域生成 Gaussian，并优化已有 Gaussian，使内存随场景范围增长而非随生成流长度增长。
AI.result: 实验表明 L3G-World 在生成质量和长时程空间一致性上达到 SOTA，同时显著降低 3D 原语数量，加速记忆更新与渲染，并实现 9 FPS 的实时世界生成。
AI.conclusion: L3G 将前馈重建效率与紧凑可渲染场景表示结合，解决了显式 3D 记忆在世界模型中的扩展性与实时性问题；其潜在高斯表征可直接服务于扩散视频生成，为长时程、实时、空间一致的交互式世界生成提供了有效路径。

title: Difficulty Calibration Across Time for Membership Inference in Diffusion Models
summary: Modern diffusion models are trained on massive datasets that often include copyrighted or private images. Membership inference attacks (MIAs) address this by testing whether a given image was in a model's training set. The standard approach scores an image by its reconstruction loss and flags low-loss images as members. This often fails because some images are simply easier to reconstruct than others, so a simple unseen image can score a lower loss than a complex training image. Difficulty calibration separates memorization from how difficult an image is to begin with. We show how to calibrate along two axes of time: training time and diffusion time. First, across training time, we introduce Reference-Model Calibration (RMC), which compares a fine-tuned model's loss against an earlier checkpoint. This cleanly isolates newly memorized data and gives near-perfect auditing, even without text captions. Since earlier checkpoints are not always available, we next present Temporal Self-Calibration (TSC), which calibrates across diffusion time using only a single model. Our key observation is that an image's difficulty persists across noise levels, whereas memorization is localized in time. By comparing the loss at a target timestep against neighboring timesteps from the same model, TSC attenuates image difficulty using the model's own trajectory. Empirically, our methods beat the state of the art by a wide margin, and unlike most existing attacks, generalize across different model parameterizations such as $x$-, $v$-, and $\epsilon$-prediction models. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 该摘要提出通过训练时间与扩散时间两个维度的难度校准，改进扩散模型成员推断攻击，显著优于现有方法并泛化到不同预测参数化。
AI.motivation: 现代扩散模型常在包含版权或隐私图片的大规模数据上训练。成员推断攻击用于判断某图像是否属于训练集，但仅按重构损失判断会被图像本身难度误导：未见过但简单的图像可能比复杂训练图像损失更低。
AI.method: 提出沿时间轴进行校准：在训练时间上引入参考模型校准（RMC），比较微调模型与更早检查点的损失以隔离新近记忆的数据；在扩散时间上引入时间自校准（TSC），仅用单个模型，比较目标时间步与相邻时间步的损失，利用“难度跨噪声级持续而记忆局部于时间”的观察来削弱图像难度。
AI.result: 实验表明方法大幅超越最先进基线，并在x、v、epsilon预测等不同模型参数化之间泛化；RMC即使没有文本标题也能近乎完美地审计，TSC不依赖更早检查点。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型成员推断的关键是将“记忆”与“图像固有难度”分离；训练时间校准和扩散时间自校准为此提供了有效路径。

title: Probing Spatial State Representations in Visual Foundation Models
summary: An observer sees only part of the surrounding world, yet must keep track of what lies beyond the current view. Spatial perception therefore involves more than recognizing individual images: it calls for a persistent spatial state that is updated under self-motion and used to guide action. Do visual foundation models provide representations that support such a state? We study this question through four levels of spatial capability---spatial structure, object persistence, predictive spatial update, and actionability---using frozen-feature probes on ten representations under streaming egocentric observations of static indoor environments. The resulting capability profiles vary across tasks, network layers, and prefix lengths: strong readout of the visible scene does not ensure accurate object persistence or future-feature retrieval. Matched controls separate readout accuracy from reliance on visual history and motion. Native future prediction retains recoverable spatial structure, but a spatial reader trained on real features does not transfer to predicted features unchanged. Finally, goal-dependent candidate selection does not establish reliable continuous action utility: predicted actions respond to goal changes, yet supplying the correct goal does not reliably improve progress. Across the four levels, object persistence and actionability build on camera-pose readout, whereas feature prediction builds on visible-scene readout. Together, these findings motivate evaluating spatial representations not only by what can be decoded from them, but by whether that information is maintained beyond observation, updated predictively, and used for goal-directed action.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过四层空间能力评估视觉基础模型在流式第一人称观察中是否支持持久空间状态：其可见场景解码较强，但对象持续、预测性更新和行动可用性并不稳定，且不同能力依赖不同表示机制。
AI.motivation: 真实空间感知不仅依赖识别当前图像，还需要在自我运动中维持、更新外部未观察场景的空间状态以指导行动。现有视觉基础模型是否具备支持这种持久空间状态的表示尚不明确，需要超越传统“可解码性”的系统评估。
AI.method: 作者在十个表示上，于静态室内环境的流式第一人称观察中，使用冻结特征探测评估四层空间能力：空间结构、对象持续性、预测性空间更新和行动可用性；并通过匹配对照区分读出精度、对历史视觉信息的依赖以及运动因素，同时比较真实特征与原生未来预测特征上的空间读出迁移，以及目标条件下的候选选择与连续行动效用。
AI.result: 能力表现因任务、网络层和前缀长度而异：可见场景的强读出并不保证对象持续性或未来特征检索准确。原生未来预测仍保留可恢复的空间结构，但在真实特征上训练的空间读出器难以直接迁移到预测特征。目标相关候选选择能响应目标变化，但提供正确目标并不总能可靠提升行动进展。总体上，对象持续性和行动性主要依赖相机位姿读出，而特征预测更依赖可见场景读出。
AI.conclusion: 视觉基础模型的空间表示不能仅以“能从中解码什么”来评价；更关键的是其信息能否在观察结束后持续保持、被预测性更新，并真正用于目标导向行动。该工作提出了一种面向持久空间状态与行动效用的分层评估框架。

title: SonoWorld4D: From One Video to a 4D Audio-Visual Scene via Diffusion Synchronization
summary: Recent progress in visual scene generation has extended beyond static 3D scenes toward the more challenging problem of generating dynamic 4D scenes from minimal input. However, sound, despite being intrinsically coupled with dynamic objects and events, remains largely unmodeled in prior work. We introduce Video-to-4DAVScene, a new task that turns a video into an explorable, time-varying 4D audio-visual scene, and present the SonoWorld4D framework for this task. Given a monocular video, our method generates a 360 static background, reconstructs explicit motion trajectories of dynamic, sound-emitting foreground objects, and synthesizes a physically-grounded sound field consistent across multiple sources through dual-space audio diffusion synchronization. The resulting 4D scene supports real-time novel-view visual and spatial audio rendering. Evaluation on real-world dynamic scenes and a user study demonstrates SonoWorld4D generates 4D audio-visual scenes with perceptually realistic, physically grounded spatial audio consistent with scene geometry and visual content.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出视频到4D音视频场景生成任务及SonoWorld4D框架，从单目视频生成可交互、时变、含真实空间音频的4D场景。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉场景生成多聚焦静态3D或动态4D视觉内容，却忽略了与运动物体和事件本质耦合的声音。真实场景中的音频不仅随时间和空间变化，还受声源运动、位置、多源叠加及物理传播影响。因此，亟需从有限视频输入生成同时具备几何合理性、运动一致性和空间音频一致性的可探索4D音视频场景。
AI.method: SonoWorld4D以单目视频为输入，构建可探索的时变4D音视频场景。方法包括：生成360°静态背景以扩展完整视觉场景；重建发声前景动态物体的显式运动轨迹，使声源与视觉对象绑定；采用双空间音频扩散同步机制，将来自多个声源、与场景几何和运动一致的物理化声音场进行统一合成；最终支持实时新视角渲染，并同时输出视觉内容与空间音频。
AI.result: 在真实动态场景和用户研究评测中，SonoWorld4D能够生成感知上真实、物理上合理且与场景几何及视觉内容一致的空间音频，同时保持可交互的4D音视频场景渲染能力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将动态场景生成从纯视觉拓展到音视频联合建模，验证了显式运动轨迹与多声源物理化音频合成在4D音视频场景生成中的有效性，为交互式沉浸媒体、虚拟现实和空间音频内容生成提供了新的框架和任务基准。

title: Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
summary: Pixel-space generative Transformers typically use one token per image patch, so capturing finer detail requires more tokens and makes global attention increasingly expensive. We observe that finer detail does not necessarily require more global communication: low-frequency structure benefits from global exchange, while high-frequency detail can be modeled locally. Based on this insight, we introduce SpecSlot, a pixel-space rectified-flow Transformer that decouples output detail from the length of the global attention sequence. SpecSlot expands each spatial anchor into multiple slots, each assigned a disjoint band of DCT coefficients; this separates anchor density from spectral subdivision. Only the lowest-frequency slot from each anchor participates in global attention, while all slots interact locally. This allows the model to increase spectral detail without enlarging the global sequence. A spatial head further adds a local correction to the spectral prediction, while the generative state, target, and loss remain in pixel space. On ImageNet-256, SpecSlot achieves a comparable final FID to a FLOPs-matched JiT control while converging faster. On ImageNet-512, it improves FID by 2.84 over the control with 3.9% fewer FLOPs, and comes within only 0.69 FID of JiT-B/16 at 38.2% lower cost. On text-to-image generation, SpecSlot surpasses JiT-B/8 on DPG-Bench by 1.06 at 40.6% lower forward cost.
comment: 22 pages, 10 figures; under review at ICLR 2027

AI.tldr: 提出 SpecSlot，一种像素空间 rectified-flow Transformer，通过将每个空间锚点扩展为多个槽位并分配不同 DCT 频段，使高频细节在局部建模、低频全局结构参与全局注意力，从而在不增加全局注意力序列长度的情况下提升生成细节与效率。
AI.motivation: 像素空间生成 Transformer 通常一个图像 patch 对应一个 token，追求更细细节需要更多 token，导致全局注意力计算成本迅速上升。本文的关键观察是：更细细节不一定需要更多全局通信，低频结构受益于全局交互，而高频细节可通过局部建模获得。
AI.method: SpecSlot 将每个空间锚点扩展为多个 slot，每个 slot 分配互不重叠的 DCT 系数频带，从而将锚点密度与频谱细分解耦。仅每个锚点中最低频 slot 参与全局注意力，所有 slot 之间进行局部交互；同时用空间头对频谱预测施加局部校正，但生成状态、目标和损失仍保留在像素空间中。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-256 上，SpecSlot 与计算量匹配的 JiT 基线达到可比最终 FID，但收敛更快。在 ImageNet-512 上，相比基线 FID 提升 2.84，且减少 3.9% FLOPs，并接近 JiT-B/16 仅差 0.69 FID，同时成本低 38.2%。在文本到图像生成上，相比 JiT-B/8 在 DPG-Bench 上提升 1.06，且前向成本低 40.6%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明像素空间图像生成可以通过频域解耦注意力结构来降低全局建模成本，在提升细节表达能力和计算效率方面具有优势。

title: LaWAM: Latent World Action Models for Efficient Dynamics-Aware Robot Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) leverage large-scale vision-language pretraining for semantic robot control, but often lack explicit foresight into how robot actions change the scene. World-Action Models (WAMs) address this limitation by conditioning policies on predicted futures, yet existing approaches typically rely on computationally expensive video generation with substantial pixel-level redundancy. We present LaWAM, a Latent World Action Model that exposes predictive dynamics to robot policies through compact latent visual subgoals instead of reconstructed future video. At the core of LaWAM is a latent-action-conditioned Latent World Model (LaWM). We obtain LaWM by training a latent action model in the latent space of a pretrained vision foundation model and repurposing its forward decoder to predict future observation features for scene evolution. LaWAM then conditions action generation on these predicted latent visual subgoals to enable dynamics-aware robot control. LaWAM achieves state-of-the-art or competitive success rates (SRs) across LIBERO (98.6% SR), RoboTwin (91.22% SR), and real-world manipulation tasks while retaining low-latency inference. LaWAM runs in 187 ms per action-chunk prediction and achieves up to 24x lower wall-clock latency than pixel-space WAMs.
comment: Accepted at CoRL 2026. Project website: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出LaWAM，一种潜在世界行动模型，用预训练视觉基础模型空间中的紧凑潜在视觉子目标替代昂贵像素级视频预测，使机器人策略具备动态感知能力并实现低延迟高效控制。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型缺少对机器人动作如何改变场景的显式预测；世界-行动模型虽能基于预测未来进行条件控制，但通常依赖计算昂贵的视频生成和大量像素级冗余。
AI.method: LaWAM的核心是动作条件化潜在世界模型LaWM。作者在预训练视觉基础模型的潜在空间中训练潜在动作模型，并复用其前向解码器预测未来观测特征，以表示场景演化。随后，动作生成过程以这些预测得到的潜在视觉子目标为条件，从而实现动态感知的机器人控制。
AI.result: LaWAM在LIBERO上达到98.6%成功率，在RoboTwin上达到91.22%成功率，并在真实世界操作任务中取得领先或具有竞争力的表现；同时保持低延迟推理，每个动作块预测仅需187 ms，比像素空间世界-行动模型快最多24倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过用潜在视觉子目标替代像素级未来视频生成，LaWAM在保留预测动态能力的同时显著降低计算开销和推理延迟，为高效、语义驱动且动态感知的机器人控制提供了可行方案。

title: TACOS: Terrain-Aware COntact Supervision for Visual Footstep Planning
summary: Humans navigate their environment based on their vision system, anticipating how the ground will respond before committing to a step. Self-supervised learning could provide legged robots the same ability, but the supervisory signal is typically chosen on intuition, and its effect on what the model learns is rarely examined. We present Terrain-Aware COntact Supervision (TACOS), which proposes a meaningful and consistent footstep instability score, based on the residual of a factor graph in legged state estimation. It projects the continuous score into preceding images to supervise a dense visual predictor. We propose two variants, a hard score that exploits hindsight and a causal soft score available immediately. Both metrics are compared against state-of-the-art alternatives in two independent evaluations that share no data or labels. On 1716 manually annotated contacts, both variants outperform every evaluated alternative at detecting instability and ranking its severity, improving pooled severity ranking by 28 % over the strongest baseline. On three outdoor test runs, our metric also trains the most accurate visual predictor, improving rank correlation by 58 % over the strongest alternative, and by a further 25 % when supplemented with onboard context. In a real-world experiment over a 50 m forest trajectory, the trained predictor handles non-geometric terrain properties such as mud and vegetation, while stepping around geometric obstacles like fallen branches. Code is available for reproducibility at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出地形感知接触监督（TACOS），利用腿部状态估计因子图残差构建连续足落点不稳定分数，并将其投影到先前图像上，以自监督方式训练密集视觉预测模型，使足式机器人能够提前判断地面是否稳定并规划落脚点。
AI.motivation: 足式机器人在复杂地形中导航时，需要像生物视觉系统一样在落地前预判地面的物理响应。现有自监督学习常依赖直觉选择监督信号，但这些信号与模型所学内容之间的关系较少被分析。因此，需要一种有意义且一致的不稳定性监督指标，用于学习从图像预测足落点稳定性的能力。
AI.method: 作者提出地形感知接触监督（TACOS）。该方法基于腿部状态估计中的因子图残差，定义一个连续的足落点不稳定性评分，并将该评分投影到接触发生前的图像上，从而监督一个密集视觉预测器。方法提出两个变体：一种利用事后信息的硬评分，另一种是实时可用的因果软评分。两种指标均在两个独立评测中与实际最先进的替代监督信号进行比较：一项基于1716个人工标注接触点评估不稳定检测与严重程度排序能力，另一项在三次室外测试轨迹中评估所训练的视觉预测器准确性，并加入机载上下文进行补充。此外，还进行了真实世界50米森林轨迹实验。
AI.result: 在1716个人工标注接触点上的实验表明，TACOS的两个变体在不稳定性检测和严重程度排序方面均优于所有被评估的替代方法；相较于最强基线，综合严重程度排序指标提升28%。在三次室外测试轨迹上，TACOS能够训练出最准确的视觉预测器，相较于最强替代方法，排序相关性提升58%；进一步结合机载上下文后，又提升25%。真实世界50米森林轨迹实验显示，该预测器能够处理泥泞和植被等非几何地形属性，并能够绕开倒伏树枝等几何障碍。
AI.conclusion: TACOS 提供了一种有意义且一致的足落点不稳定性监督信号，相较于常见自监督方案，能够更有效训练足式机器人的密集视觉地形稳定性预测模型。该方法不仅提升不稳定性检测与严重程度排序能力，还能使机器人在真实复杂环境中识别非几何地形属性并进行更安全的落脚规划。

title: Efficacy of Monocular Depth Estimation in Lunar Environments
summary: Recent advances in monocular depth estimation have demonstrated highly accurate 3D reconstructions within in-distribution terrestrial domains. This study investigates the efficacy of several state-of-the-art approaches to reconstruct out-of-distribution lunar environments using the NASA Ames Polar Optical Lunar Analog Reconstruction (POLAR) stereo dataset and Apollo 17 surface imagery. By leveraging these datasets, we establish a robust analog-to-field validation pipeline that evaluates quantitative performance against ground-truth physical analogs and qualitative performance against historical field data. Our results indicate that select state-of-the-art techniques can successfully generalize to produce high-fidelity relative 3D reconstructions of the unstructured lunar surface.
comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Space Robotics (iSpaRo) 2026

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了单目深度估计方法在月面等非地面分布场景中的泛化能力，发现部分先进方法可生成高保真的相对三维月面重建。
AI.motivation: 现有单目深度估计在地球陆地场景中已达到较高精度，但其在月球等分布外环境中的适用性仍未被充分验证；亟需建立可量化的评测流程来判断这些模型能否用于月面三维重建。
AI.method: 利用 NASA Ames POLAR 立体视觉数据集和 Apollo 17 月面影像，构建“模拟环境到真实任务”的验证流程：一方面以物理模拟真值进行定量评估，另一方面以历史月面影像进行定性评估。
AI.result: 结果表明，部分最先进的单目深度估计方法能够较好地泛化到无结构的月面环境，并生成高保真的相对三维重建。
AI.conclusion: 单目深度估计模型在月球表面重建任务中具有潜力，但需要借助真实数据与模拟数据联合验证来评估其跨分布泛化能力；当前结果更支持相对深度重建的有效性。

title: EgoContact: Evaluating Physical Intelligence with Egocentric Video
summary: Egocentric video has emerged as one of the most scalable sources of data for learning generalizable manipulation priors. Yet, despite its growing use in pretraining robotic policies, it has been underutilized as a validation tool for physical intelligence, a key component of which is understanding where to make contact with an object to achieve an intended interaction. We present EgoContact, a large-scale egocentric dataset for evaluating the generalizability and precision of learned manipulation priors through future contact-point prediction. EgoContact contains 22.5K manually verified interaction events, each with a pre-contact observation, semantic intent, and pixel-precise contact locations. We find that current methods often struggle to predict precise interaction contacts and sometimes fail to localize the target object in diverse, in-the-wild scenes, even when allowed multiple predictions. Furthermore, we demonstrate the usefulness of EgoContact's annotated interactions for robotic manipulation: simply using EgoContact as the memory bank of an existing affordance-transfer policy improves grasp success from 14.2% to 31.2% in simulation and from 16% to 58% on a real robot.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出EgoContact，一个大规模第一视角交互数据集，通过未来接触点预测来评估机器人操作先验的泛化性与精度，并证明其标注可显著提升机器人抓取成功率。
AI.motivation: 第一视角视频虽已广泛用于预训练机器人操作策略，但较少被用作验证物理智能的数据源；尤其在理解“为实现特定交互应在物体的什么位置发生接触”方面，现有方法缺乏精细、可靠的评估基准。
AI.method: 作者构建EgoContact数据集，包含22.5万个人工核验的交互事件。每个事件包括交互前的观测、语义意图和像素级接触位置。基于该数据集，评估现有方法在复杂真实场景中预测未来精确接触点和定位目标物体的能力，并将数据集作为已有affordance transfer策略的记忆库，用于机器人抓取任务。
AI.result: 实验表明，现有方法往往难以预测精确交互接触点，且在多样真实场景中即使允许多次预测，也可能无法准确定位目标物体。将EgoContact作为策略记忆库后，仿真中的抓取成功率从14.2%提升至31.2%，真实机器人上的成功率从16%提升至58%。
AI.conclusion: EgoContact为评估机器人操作先验提供了大规模、像素级精确且面向未来接触点预测的第一视角基准；其人工核验的交互标注不仅能揭示当前方法在接触点预测上的不足，也能直接提升机器人抓取性能，说明第一视角数据在物理智能验证与机器人操作迁移中具有实用价值。

title: EmbodiExp: Compositional Experience Transfer for Embodied Agents
summary: Experience can help embodied agents turn high-level plans into grounded actions, but transferring it across tasks remains challenging: previously effective strategies may be inapplicable to the current state or fail to produce their intended outcomes. We present EmbodiExp, a framework for constructing transferable experiences and composing them online during embodied task execution. Our key observation is that tasks often share subgoals whose completion can be assessed independently of overall task success. We therefore introduce an outcome-grounded subgoal experience that specifies a subgoal, applicability conditions, an adaptable policy, and a verifiable outcome. During execution, applicable experiences guide action generation, while verified outcomes can establish the conditions required by subsequent experiences, enabling online composition. Subgoal-level outcome attribution further enables failure utilization: failed trajectories can still contribute verified local successes and condition-specific guidance on actions to avoid. Experiments on multiple embodied benchmarks under a fold-based protocol with frozen experience banks demonstrate the effectiveness of EmbodiExp.

AI.tldr: EmbodiExp 将具身任务经验组织为“结果可验证的子目标经验”，并通过在线适用性判断与结果验证实现跨任务经验组合与失败轨迹再利用。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体在把高层计划转化为可落地动作时依赖以往经验，但跨任务迁移困难：过去有效的策略可能不适用于当前状态，或无法产生预期结果。
AI.method: 提出 EmbodiExp 框架，核心是将任务分解为可独立评估完成度的子目标，并构造包含子目标、适用条件、可调整策略和可验证结果的 outcome-grounded subgoal experience。执行时仅检索当前状态可适用的经验指导动作生成；已验证的子目标结果满足后续经验的前置条件，从而支持在线经验组合。进一步采用子目标级结果归因，使失败轨迹也能贡献已验证的局部成功和针对特定状态的避错指导。
AI.result: 在多个具身基准上，基于 fold-based protocol 且经验库冻结的实验表明 EmbodiExp 具有有效性，验证了结构化经验在跨任务执行与在线组合中的优势。
AI.conclusion: 将经验锚定到可验证子目标及其适用条件，有助于解决具身智能体经验迁移与在线使用难题；即使整体任务失败，也能通过子目标级归因保留可复用局部经验。

title: Decoding Geometry, Not Tokens: Efficient VLMs for Robot Affordance and Trajectory Prediction
summary: Predicting where to grasp and how to move is fundamentally a geometry problem. Vision-language models treat it as language generation instead. They tokenize spatial coordinates into text and decode them autoregressively. This mechanism ignores spatial structure and truncates continuous precision. Errors compound across coordinate tokens during decoding. In this paper, we show that compact off-the-shelf VLMs with 0.5-2B parameters already encode rich spatial information in their intermediate hidden states. Autoregressive decoding is the dominant bottleneck for trajectory prediction, while affordance prediction depends additionally on feature depth and decoder architecture. We expose the latent spatial information with a lightweight, geometry-compatible prediction head that attaches to a frozen backbone. It reads features from an intermediate hidden layer, conditions a learned query on the task instruction and refines it via cross-attention over the visual tokens to regress affordance boxes and trajectory waypoints directly as continuous values, without modifying the backbone. We evaluate on ShareRobot-Bench and AGD20K. Our 2B variant reduces trajectory error by over 60% and improves ShareRobot-Bench affordance mAP by 85% relative to the autoregressive baseline. It approaches RoboBrain on trajectory prediction (0.251 vs 0.191 DFD) at 3.8x higher throughput. These results demonstrate a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off for instruction-conditioned 2D geometric prediction.
comment: IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027)

AI.tldr: 论文指出抓取点和轨迹预测本质上是几何问题，而现有视觉语言模型把空间坐标当作文本进行自回归生成，导致精度损失和误差累积；作者发现小参数VLM的中间隐藏状态已包含丰富空间信息，并通过冻结主干加轻量连续回归头显著提升几何预测精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 传统VLM将坐标token化并自回归解码，破坏了空间连续性、限制了精度，并使误差在解码过程中累积。机器人/具身场景中“在哪里抓”和“如何移动”需要连续几何预测，因此需要避免语言式解码瓶颈，直接从VLM内部空间表征进行回归。
AI.method: 使用0.5–2B参数的现成VLM作为冻结骨干，观察到其中间隐藏层已编码丰富空间信息。设计轻量、几何兼容的预测头：从中间隐藏层读取特征，以任务指令条件化一个可学习查询，并通过跨注意力在视觉token上精炼查询，直接连续回归affordance框和轨迹路点。不修改骨干网络。
AI.result: 在ShareRobot-Bench和AGD20K上评估。相比自回归基线，2B模型将轨迹误差降低超过60%，ShareRobot-Bench affordance mAP提升85%。在轨迹预测上接近更大的RoboBrain（DFD 0.251 vs 0.191），同时吞吐量高3.8倍。分析表明自回归解码是轨迹预测的主要瓶颈，而affordance预测还受特征深度和解码器结构影响。
AI.conclusion: 将VLM中的潜在空间信息用连续几何回归头显式暴露出来，比把几何任务当作语言生成更有效，可在指令条件化2D几何预测中取得更好的精度与效率权衡。

title: How Much Should a VLA Trust Its Reasoning? Step-Level Guidance as a Measured Action-Value Function
summary: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) policies write a reasoning trace and then decode the action from it. A wrong trace yields a wrong action, and even a correct-looking trace can mislead the plan. Existing remedies ask whether the reasoning is right. We ask how strongly it should steer. CoC-CFG applies classifier-free guidance between the policy's context and the same context without the reasoning span. One weight per Euler step attenuates or amplifies the reasoning, and w=1 recovers the original policy. We treat the choice of this weight as a Markov decision process whose action values are measured, not bootstrapped. With the expert frozen and the noise fixed, applying a weight for one step and finishing the plan under the current controller returns that weight's value exactly. Q-adaptive guidance fits these values with small critics and improves the controller conservatively. In the Alpasim driving simulator it outperforms every fixed weight and online RL (SAC, GRPO) in open loop, and in closed loop it passes 262 of 300 scenes, against 252 for the original policy. On held-out frames of the Waymo end-to-end driving benchmark, its first three stages outperform every fixed weight, four adaptive-guidance methods, SAC and GRPO. On the hidden test set, a frozen Alpamayo 1.5 with rule-based camera and vehicle conversions and Q-adaptive guidance sets a new state of the art among published methods: 8.135159 rater feedback score, against 8.079 for the best published method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoC-CFG与Q-adaptive guidance，将推理轨迹在VLA策略中的影响强度建模为可优化的权重，而非判断推理是否正确；在自动驾驶开环与闭环仿真中显著优于固定权重和常见在线RL方法，并在Waymo端到端测试集上刷新公开方法SOTA。
AI.motivation: 推理视觉-语言-动作策略先生成推理轨迹再解码动作，但错误推理会导致错误动作，即使看似正确的推理也可能误导最终规划。传统方法多关注推理是否“正确”，而忽略了推理应被多大强度地用于引导动作生成，因此需要更稳定、可量化的控制机制。
AI.method:
1. 提出CoC-CFG：在包含推理轨迹的上下文与去掉推理轨迹的上下文之间进行无分类器引导，以单个权重控制每个Euler步骤中推理的影响；w=1恢复原策略。
2. 将权重选择建模为Markov决策过程，并直接测量动作价值，而非使用bootstrapping估计。
3. 在专家策略冻结、噪声固定的条件下，对某一步施加权重并沿用当前控制器完成规划，可得到该权重的真实价值。
4. 训练小型critic拟合这些价值，实现保守更新的Q-adaptive guidance。
AI.result: 在Alpasim驾驶模拟器中，Q-adaptive guidance在开环表现优于所有固定权重方法以及SAC、GRPO等在线RL；闭环中300个场景通过262个，优于原策略的252个。在Waymo端到端驾驶基准的保留帧上，其前三个阶段均优于固定权重、四种自适应引导方法、SAC和GRPO。在隐藏测试集上，使用冻结的Alpamayo 1.5、规则化相机/车辆转换和Q-adaptive guidance后，评分达到8.135159，超过最佳公开方法8.079。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接度量并优化推理引导权重，该方法把“推理是否可信”转化为“推理应多大程度影响动作生成”，为VLA策略中的推理控制提供了稳定且可验证的机制，在自动驾驶规划任务中带来明确性能提升并达到新SOTA。

title: Decision-Level Error Attribution and Depth-Aware Safety Evaluation of Monocular RGB Human Tracking for Autonomous Robot Navigation
summary: Monocular RGB tracking is useful for robots operating near people, but perception errors affect binary stop/proceed decisions in ways that geometric accuracy metrics do not capture. We examine how much decision error arises from the safety rule versus perception. We prove that lateral-only distance is a lower bound on planar distance: with accurate positions, it cannot miss dangers identified by the planar rule, but it produces unnecessary stops. We introduce a two-factor Shapley attribution separating rule and perception contributions, and further distinguish missed detections from localization errors. Experiments use ETH and UCY pedestrian videos with simulated stationary robots, disjoint calibration and evaluation pedestrians, and time-block bootstrap intervals. Across 898 pedestrians in three scenes, the lateral rule missed no dangers on annotated positions but achieved only 5.6-31.9% stop precision. In two scenes with RGB perception, calibrated ground-plane localization achieved 0.59 m and 0.51 m planar RMSE, compared with 1.72 m and 1.39 m for a geometric baseline and 0.81 m and 0.68 m for calibrated Depth Anything V2. Detection recall of 0.43 and 0.26 made missed detections the leading source of missed danger. A two-standard-deviation safety margin with ground-plane localization matched or improved on the lateral rule's missed-danger rate in all eight scene-threshold settings and reduced unnecessary stops in seven. All robot interactions are simulated, and outcomes are offline decision classifications, not demonstrations of collision avoidance.

AI.tldr: 本文分析单目RGB行人感知误差如何影响近人机器人的停止/通行安全决策，提出区分“安全规则误差”和“感知误差”的归因方法，并证明横向距离规则虽不漏危险但会造成大量误停。
AI.motivation: 单目RGB跟踪可用于人附近机器人，但几何定位精度指标无法充分解释其对二元安全决策的影响。作者希望量化漏危险和错误停止究竟来自安全规则还是感知误差。
AI.method: 理论上证明横向距离是平面距离的下界；提出两因子Shapley归因方法分离规则与感知对决策误差的贡献，并区分漏检与定位误差；在ETH和UCY数据集上用模拟静止机器人、不重叠标定/评估行人和时间块bootstrap进行评估。
AI.result: 898名行人实验中，横向距离规则在标注位置上未漏掉任何危险，但停止精确率仅5.6%-31.9%。RGB感知下，校准地面平面定位的平面RMSE为0.59m和0.51m，优于几何基线的1.72m和1.39m，也优于校准Depth Anything V2的0.81m和0.68m；低检测召回率导致漏检成为漏危险的主要来源。采用两标准差安全裕度的地面平面定位在8个场景阈值设置中均匹配或改善漏危险率，并在7个设置中减少错误停止。
AI.conclusion: 机器人安全决策误差同时受规则保守性和感知误差影响，其中检测漏检往往是漏危险的主因。校准地面平面定位结合统计安全裕度可在不牺牲甚至改善漏危险表现的同时减少误停；但所有结果基于模拟和离线决策分类，不能视为真实碰撞规避验证。

title: Continuous-Action World Models: Learning Cross-Embodiment Spatiotemporal Dynamics Priors
summary: We introduce Continuous-Action World Models (CoAWM), a framework for learning cross-embodiment spatiotemporal dynamics priors that support robot action generation across embodiments and execution frequencies. At its core is a shared latent function space that captures the spatial and temporal structure of robot actions. We learn this space through two stages. First, function pretraining brings trajectories from different embodiments and sampling frequencies into a common representation, learning shared dynamics priors through action reconstruction and consistency across temporal sampling views. By accommodating heterogeneous robot trajectories, this stage broadens the range of data sources available for pretraining and facilitates scaling to larger and more diverse datasets. Second, we connect the pretrained function space to a world-model backbone, enabling observations, language instructions, and the current robot state to condition the prediction of a latent action function. A single decoder takes any query time and returns the corresponding end-effector action. By separating shared dynamics priors from task-conditioned action selection and temporal sampling, our approach provides a unified foundation for transferring robot experience across embodiments and control frequencies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出连续动作世界模型（CoAWM），通过共享潜在函数空间学习跨具身与跨执行频率的机器人动作时空动态先验，并以统一解码方式生成条件化的机器人动作。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人学习难以有效整合不同本体形态、采样频率和控制周期的异构轨迹数据，因此需要一种统一表示机器人动作时空结构的框架，以支持更大规模、更多样化的预训练，并实现跨具身经验迁移。
AI.method: 该方法首先进行函数预训练，将不同机器人本体和不同采样频率下的轨迹映射到共同表示，并通过动作重建与时序多采样视图一致性学习共享动态先验；随后将该预训练函数空间接入世界模型主干，使观测、语言指令和当前机器人状态能够条件化预测潜在动作函数，最后由单一解码器根据任意查询时间输出对应末端执行器动作。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验指标或定量结果，但表明该方法能够容纳异构机器人轨迹，扩展可用预训练数据范围，并将共享动态先验与任务条件化动作选择及时序采样分离，为跨具身、跨控制频率的动作生成提供统一基础。
AI.conclusion: CoAWM 通过连续潜在函数空间与世界模型结合，实现了跨具身、跨频率的机器人动作动态建模与生成，为大规模机器人经验迁移和通用动作控制提供了统一框架。

title: SymAnt: Grounding Long-Horizon Action Anticipation with Adaptable Symbolic Priors
summary: As robots and intelligent systems increasingly interact with humans, they must anticipate long sequences of future actions from only brief observations. While purely neural models typically require extensive observations to predict future actions and remain difficult to interpret and adjust, symbolic priors offer a structured alternative. To this end, we introduce SymAnt, a novel neuro-symbolic approach that unifies the expressiveness of neural networks with the structured reasoning of scene and knowledge graphs. Given a short video, SymAnt performs a joint-search over both graphs to construct a symbolic context, enabling unified reasoning over spatial relationships, object attributes, affordances, and associated actions. This symbolic context serves as a prior for an iterative refinement process that progressively generates and improves the sequence of future actions. By grounding predictions in symbolic context, SymAnt anticipates long-horizon actions from short observation windows in a parameter-efficient manner, while enabling users to directly edit the underlying knowledge to adjust predictions without further training. Through our experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of SymAnt, particularly when only short observation contexts are available, across five diverse datasets: Breakfast, 50 Salads, EPIC-KITCHENS, EGTEA Gaze+, and Assembly101.

AI.tldr: SymAnt是一种神经符号方法，通过联合搜索场景图与知识图构建符号上下文，作为先验指导迭代优化，从而仅凭短时视频观察预测长序列未来动作，并支持通过编辑知识直接调整预测。
AI.motivation: 机器人与智能系统在交互中需从短暂观察中预判长时动作序列，但纯神经模型通常需要大量观察、难以解释和调整；符号先验可提供结构化推理能力。因此需要一种兼顾神经表达能力与符号可解释、可编辑性的方法。
AI.method: 给定短视频，SymAnt在场景图和知识图上进行联合搜索，构建统一的符号上下文，以表征空间关系、物体属性、可供性及相关动作。该符号上下文作为先验，参与迭代优化过程，逐步生成并改进未来动作序列，使预测基于可编辑的符号知识。
AI.result: 在Breakfast、50 Salads、EPIC-KITCHENS、EGTEA Gaze+和Assembly101五个数据集上验证了方法有效性，尤其在观察上下文较短时表现突出；同时体现出参数高效和无需重新训练即可通过编辑知识调整预测的能力。
AI.conclusion: 将图结构化的符号先验与神经模型结合，能够改善短时观察下的长时动作预测，并提升可解释性与用户可控性，适用于需要交互式、可编辑预测能力的机器人与智能系统。
